import React from 'react'
import { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { ShieldAlert, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { getMaintenanceOverview } from '@/app/actions/maintenance'
import { getWorkstationBoardData, getDiagnosticsTriageData } from '@/app/actions/workstations'
import MaintenanceClientPage from '@/components/maintenance/maintenance-client-page'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Lab Diagnostics & Maintenance | LabSync LIMS',
  description:
    'Institutional Lab Diagnostics, Workstation Health Triage, Computer Servicing & Recurrence Reminders',
}

export default async function MaintenancePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ search?: string; station?: string; tab?: string }>
}) {
  const resolvedParams = searchParams ? await searchParams : {}
  const initialSearch = resolvedParams.search || resolvedParams.station || ''
  const initialTab = (resolvedParams.tab as 'diagnostics' | 'tasks' | 'history') || undefined

  const [data, workstationData, triageData] = await Promise.all([
    getMaintenanceOverview('all'),
    getWorkstationBoardData('comp'),
    getDiagnosticsTriageData('comp'),
  ])

  if (!data.authorized) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto my-16 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-center font-sans space-y-4 shadow-sm">
        <div className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-amber-500/20">
          <ShieldAlert className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
            Restricted Lab Access
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            The Lab Maintenance module is restricted to Laboratory In-Charges,
            Assigned Technicians, Academic Coordinators, and Administrators.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="pt-2">
          <Link href="/">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-9 text-xs rounded-xl gap-1.5">
              <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Return to Dashboard</span>
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <MaintenanceClientPage
      initialData={data}
      initialWorkstationData={workstationData}
      initialTriageData={triageData}
      initialSearch={initialSearch}
      initialTab={initialTab}
    />
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { getPracticalLogs, getActiveLabs } from '@/app/actions/logs'
import DailyLogSheetView, { PracticalLogItem } from '@/components/print/daily-log-sheet-view'

export default async function DailyLogPrintPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ date?: string; lab_id?: string }>
}) {
  const params = await searchParams
  const date = params.date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
  const labId = params.lab_id || 'all'

  const [rawLogs, labs] = await Promise.all([
    getPracticalLogs({ date, lab_id: labId === 'all' ? undefined : labId }),
    getActiveLabs(),
  ])

  const logs = rawLogs as unknown as PracticalLogItem[]

  const selectedLab = labs.find((l) => l.id === labId)
  const labDisplayName = selectedLab ? selectedLab.name : 'All Science & Engineering Laboratories'

  return (
    <DailyLogSheetView
      initialLogs={logs}
      labs={labs}
      date={date}
      labId={labId}
      labDisplayName={labDisplayName}
    />
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useEffect, useState, use, useMemo } from 'react'
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { INSTITUTION_CONFIG } from '@/lib/institution'
import { getIncidentRecords, getPrintSelectionSessionAction } from '@/app/actions/records'
import { IncidentRecordItem, IncidentSummaryMetrics } from '@/types/records'
import PrintLayout from '@/components/print/print-layout'
import { incidentReportSpec } from '@/lib/report-spec/incident-spec'
import { formatClassCode } from '@/lib/report-spec/practical-spec'
import { searchParamsToFilters, truncateAtWordBoundary, resolveExportPrintScope } from '@/lib/report-spec/filter-codec'
import { FootnoteEntry, PrintDensityMode } from '@/types/report-spec'
import { formatToNepaliMiti } from '@/lib/nepali-date'

interface PrintIncidentsPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>
}

export default function PrintIncidentsPage({ searchParams }: PrintIncidentsPageProps) {
  const rawParams = use(searchParams)
  const filters = useMemo(() => searchParamsToFilters(rawParams), [rawParams])

  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<IncidentRecordItem[]>([])
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<IncidentSummaryMetrics | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [resolvedSelectedIds, setResolvedSelectedIds] = useState<string[] | undefined>(undefined)

  // Refinement #4: Clean SSR hydration: initialize deterministically, read localStorage only on mount
  const [densityMode, setDensityMode] = useState<PrintDensityMode>(filters.density || 'detailed')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!filters.density && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('lmr_print_density_mode') as PrintDensityMode | null
        if (saved === 'compact' || saved === 'detailed') {
          setDensityMode(saved)
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [filters.density])

  const labId = filters.lab_id || 'all'
  const severity = filters.severity || 'all'
  const status = filters.status || 'all'
  const dateFrom = filters.date_from || ''
  const dateTo = filters.date_to || ''

  // Resolve active visible columns with Refinement #3: Context-aware dynamic column pruning
  const visibleColSet = useMemo(() => {
    if (filters.cols && filters.cols.trim()) {
      return new Set(filters.cols.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean))
    }
    const defaultCols = new Set(['date_case', 'facility', 'equipment', 'title_circ', 'severity', 'teacher_batch', 'status', 'resolution'])
    if (labId !== 'all') defaultCols.delete('facility')
    return defaultCols
  }, [filters.cols, labId])

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true)
      try {
        let activeSelectedIds: string[] | undefined = undefined
        if (filters.selected) {
          activeSelectedIds = filters.selected.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        } else if (filters.selKey) {
          const tokenRes = await getPrintSelectionSessionAction(filters.selKey)
          if (tokenRes.success && tokenRes.ids.length > 0) {
            activeSelectedIds = tokenRes.ids
          }
        }
        setResolvedSelectedIds(activeSelectedIds)

        const res = await getIncidentRecords({
          lab_id: labId,
          severity: severity as any,
          status: status as any,
          incident_type: filters.incident_type,
          search: filters.search,
          date_from: dateFrom,
          date_to: dateTo,
          sortKey: filters.sortKey,
          sortDirection: filters.sortDirection,
          selected_ids: activeSelectedIds,
        })
        if (res.success) {
          setIncidents(res.incidents)
          setMetrics(res.metrics)
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }
    loadData()
  }, [
    labId,
    severity,
    status,
    filters.incident_type,
    filters.search,
    dateFrom,
    dateTo,
    filters.selected,
    filters.selKey,
    filters.sortKey,
    filters.sortDirection,
  ])

  const scope = useMemo(() => {
    return resolveExportPrintScope({
      selectedIds: resolvedSelectedIds,
      isAllMatchingSelected: Boolean(filters.selectedAll),
      totalCount: metrics?.totalIncidents || 0,
      filters,
      sortKey: filters.sortKey,
      sortDirection: filters.sortDirection,
    })
  }, [resolvedSelectedIds, filters, metrics])

  const labDisplayName =
    labId === 'comp'
      ? 'Computer Engineering Lab 01'
      : labId === 'phys'
      ? 'Physics Laboratory'
      : labId === 'chem'
      ? 'Chemistry Laboratory'
      : labId === 'bio'
      ? 'Biology & Life Sciences Lab'
      : labId === 'elec'
      ? 'Electronics & Hardware Lab'
      : 'All Laboratories (Consolidated)'

  const dateRangeLabel =
    dateFrom && dateTo
      ? `${dateFrom} to ${dateTo}`
      : dateFrom
      ? `From ${dateFrom}`
      : dateTo
      ? `Up to ${dateTo}`
      : 'All Incident History'

  // Extract column specs
  const colDate = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'date_case')!
  const colFacility = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'facility')!
  const colEquipment = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'equipment')!
  const colCirc = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'title_circ')!
  const colSeverity = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'severity')!
  const colTeacher = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'teacher_batch')!
  const colStatus = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'status')!
  const colResolution = incidentReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'resolution')!

  // Dynamic footnote generation & word-boundary truncation
  const { computedIncidents, footnotes } = useMemo(() => {
    const notes: FootnoteEntry[] = []

    const processed = incidents.map((inc, idx) => {
      const rowId = `Row #${idx + 1} (${inc.date || inc.created_at?.split('T')[0]} | ${inc.labs?.name || 'Lab'})`

      // 1. Circumstances / Description Truncation
      let circDisplay = inc.title || '—'
      let circFootnoteIdx: number | null = null
      if (inc.title && inc.title.trim().length > 0) {
        const maxCirc = colCirc.print[densityMode].maxChars
        const res = truncateAtWordBoundary(inc.title, maxCirc)
        if (res.truncated) {
          const fnIdx = notes.length + 1
          circFootnoteIdx = fnIdx
          notes.push({
            index: fnIdx,
            rowIdentifier: rowId,
            fieldName: 'Circumstances',
            fullText: inc.title.trim(),
          })
          circDisplay = res.text
        }
      }

      // 2. Resolution Notes Truncation
      let resDisplay = inc.resolution_notes || ''
      let resFootnoteIdx: number | null = null
      if (inc.resolution_notes && inc.resolution_notes.trim().length > 0) {
        const maxRes = colResolution.print[densityMode].maxChars
        const resNotes = truncateAtWordBoundary(inc.resolution_notes, maxRes)
        if (resNotes.truncated) {
          const fnIdx = notes.length + 1
          resFootnoteIdx = fnIdx
          notes.push({
            index: fnIdx,
            rowIdentifier: rowId,
            fieldName: 'Resolution Notes',
            fullText: inc.resolution_notes.trim(),
          })
          resDisplay = resNotes.text
        }
      }

      return {
        ...inc,
        _circDisplay: circDisplay,
        _circFootnoteIdx: circFootnoteIdx,
        _resDisplay: resDisplay,
        _resFootnoteIdx: resFootnoteIdx,
      }
    })

    return { computedIncidents: processed, footnotes: notes }
  }, [incidents, densityMode, colCirc, colResolution])

  return (
    <PrintLayout
      icon={AlertTriangle}
      title="Official Incident & Damage Register Sheet"
      subtitle="A4 landscape register for equipment breakages and repair history."
      backHref="/records/incidents"
      backLabel="Back to Register"
      printButtonLabel="Print / Save to PDF"
      printButtonColorClass="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700"
      densityMode={densityMode}
      onDensityModeChange={setDensityMode}
      documentTitleBadge="OFFICIAL LABORATORY EQUIPMENT DAMAGE & SAFETY INCIDENT REGISTER"
      fontSerif={true}
      signatureTier="2-tier"
      footerNote={scope.traceabilityNote}
      footnotes={footnotes}
      metadataGrid={
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 mb-6 text-xs font-sans print:grid-cols-4 print:gap-2 print:p-1.5 print:mb-2 print:bg-transparent print:border-y print:border-zinc-800 print:rounded-none print:text-[7.5pt]">
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[10px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Target Facility</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 text-sm print:text-[8pt]">{labDisplayName}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[10px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Audit Window</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">{dateRangeLabel}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[10px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Recorded Incidents</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">
              {metrics ? `${metrics.totalIncidents} Case(s)` : '...'}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[10px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Status Breakdown</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">
              {metrics
                ? `${metrics.resolvedCount} Resolved | ${metrics.openCount} Open`
                : '...'}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-4 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 font-mono text-[11px] flex items-center justify-between print:col-span-4 print:pt-0.5 print:mt-0.5 print:border-t print:border-zinc-300 print:text-[7pt]">
            <span>{scope.traceabilityNote}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      {/* Table */}
      <div className="border border-zinc-900 rounded-md overflow-x-auto mb-6 print:border-0 print:m-0 print:rounded-none print:mb-4 print:overflow-visible print-dense-table">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs font-sans print:text-[8.5pt]">
          <thead className="print:table-header-group">
            <tr className="bg-zinc-100 border-b border-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 uppercase font-mono font-bold text-[10px] print:text-[8pt] print:h-6">
              {visibleColSet.has('date_case') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colDate.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  {colDate.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('facility') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colFacility.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  {colFacility.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('equipment') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colEquipment.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  {colEquipment.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('title_circ') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colCirc.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  {colCirc.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('severity') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colSeverity.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 text-center"
                >
                  {colSeverity.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('teacher_batch') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colTeacher.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  {colTeacher.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('status') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colStatus.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 text-center"
                >
                  {colStatus.label}
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('resolution') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colResolution.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5"
                >
                  {colResolution.label}
                </th>
              )}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-300 print:divide-zinc-400">
            {computedIncidents.length === 0 || loading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={visibleColSet.size || 8} className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-500 font-mono italic">
                  {loading ? 'Loading incident records...' : 'No incident logs recorded for this selected criteria.'}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              computedIncidents.map((inc: any) => (
                <tr key={inc.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50/60 break-inside-avoid print:break-inside-avoid print:leading-[1.15]">
                  {visibleColSet.has('date_case') && (() => {
                    const rawDate = inc.date || inc.created_at?.split('T')[0]
                    const miti = formatToNepaliMiti(rawDate)
                    return (
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 font-mono align-top text-[11px] print:text-[8pt]">
                        <div className="font-bold">{miti ? miti.bsFormattedNp : rawDate}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] text-zinc-500 font-mono">#{inc.id.slice(-6).toUpperCase()}</div>
                      </td>
                    )
                  })()}
                  {visibleColSet.has('facility') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 font-medium align-top print:text-[8pt]">
                      {inc.labs?.name?.split(' ')[0] || inc.lab_id?.toUpperCase()} Lab
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('equipment') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top">
                      <div className="font-bold text-zinc-950 print:text-[8.5pt]">
                        {inc.equipment_name} {inc.quantity ? `(x${inc.quantity})` : ''}
                      </div>
                      {inc.student_rolls && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
                          Student Roll: {inc.student_rolls}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('title_circ') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] text-zinc-800">
                      <div>
                        {inc._circDisplay}
                        {inc._circFootnoteIdx && (
                          <sup className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 print:text-zinc-950 ml-0.5">
                            [{inc._circFootnoteIdx}]
                          </sup>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('severity') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 text-center font-mono align-top uppercase text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt] font-bold">
                      <span
                        className={
                          inc.severity === 'major_critical' || inc.severity === 'critical'
                            ? 'text-rose-700 font-extrabold'
                            : inc.severity === 'moderate' || inc.severity === 'high'
                            ? 'text-amber-700 font-bold'
                            : 'text-sky-700'
                        }
                      >
                        {String(inc.severity).replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('teacher_batch') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top text-[11px] print:text-[8pt]">
                      <div className="font-medium text-zinc-900">{inc.subject_teacher_name || inc.reporter_profile?.full_name || 'Staff'}</div>
                      <div className="text-zinc-500 text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt]">{formatClassCode(inc.batch_name) || inc.batch_name || 'General Class'}</div>
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('status') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 text-center align-top font-mono text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt] font-bold uppercase">
                      <div className={inc.status === 'resolved' ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-amber-700'}>
                        {String(inc.status).replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                      </div>
                      {inc.escalated_to_hod && (
                        <div className="text-[9px] print:text-[7pt] text-rose-600 font-sans mt-0.5 font-bold">HOD Escalated</div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}
                  {visibleColSet.has('resolution') && (
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 align-top text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] text-zinc-700">
                      {inc.resolution_notes ? (
                        <div>
                          <div className="italic">
                            "{inc._resDisplay}"
                            {inc._resFootnoteIdx && (
                              <sup className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 print:text-zinc-950 ml-0.5">
                                [{inc._resFootnoteIdx}]
                              </sup>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {inc.resolved_by && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
                              Certified: {inc.resolved_by}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-zinc-400 italic">Under inspection</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </PrintLayout>
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { Metadata } from 'next'
import { getMaintenanceOverview } from '@/app/actions/maintenance'
import PrintMaintenanceView from '@/components/maintenance/print-maintenance-view'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Certified Lab Maintenance & Servicing Logbook | Print Sheet',
  description:
    'Official A4 landscape certified maintenance logbook with 3-tier signature block',
}

interface PrintMaintenancePageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    lab_id?: string
  }>
}

export default async function PrintMaintenancePage({ searchParams }: PrintMaintenancePageProps) {
  const params = await searchParams
  const labId = params.lab_id || 'all'
  const data = await getMaintenanceOverview(labId)

  return <PrintMaintenanceView data={data} labId={labId} />
}

'use client'

import React, { useEffect, useState, use, useMemo } from 'react'
import { Printer } from 'lucide-react'
import { INSTITUTION_CONFIG } from '@/lib/institution'
import { getPracticalRecords, getPrintSelectionSessionAction } from '@/app/actions/records'
import { PracticalGroupedSection, PracticalSummaryMetrics } from '@/types/records'
import PrintLayout from '@/components/print/print-layout'
import {
  practicalReportSpec,
  formatClassCode,
  sanitizeSubjectTitle,
  cleanSubjectCode,
  cleanPracticalTitle,
  formatFacilityShortCode,
} from '@/lib/report-spec/practical-spec'
import { searchParamsToFilters, truncateAtWordBoundary, resolveExportPrintScope } from '@/lib/report-spec/filter-codec'
import { FootnoteEntry, PrintDensityMode } from '@/types/report-spec'
import { formatToNepaliMiti } from '@/lib/nepali-date'

interface PrintRecordsPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>
}

export default function PrintRecordsPage({ searchParams }: PrintRecordsPageProps) {
  const rawParams = use(searchParams)
  const filters = useMemo(() => searchParamsToFilters(rawParams), [rawParams])

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<PracticalGroupedSection[]>([])
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<PracticalSummaryMetrics | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [resolvedSelectedIds, setResolvedSelectedIds] = useState<string[] | undefined>(undefined)
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; isCurrent: boolean }>>([])
  const [activeAcademicYearId, setActiveAcademicYearId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Refinement #4: Clean SSR hydration: initialize deterministically, read localStorage only on mount
  const [densityMode, setDensityMode] = useState<PrintDensityMode>(filters.density || 'detailed')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!filters.density && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('lmr_print_density_mode') as PrintDensityMode | null
        if (saved === 'compact' || saved === 'detailed') {
          setDensityMode(saved)
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }, [filters.density])

  const academicYearId = filters.academic_year_id || (filters as any).year || 'all'
  const labId = filters.lab_id || 'all'
  const dateFrom = filters.date_from || ''
  const dateTo = filters.date_to || ''
  const groupBy = (filters.groupBy as any) || 'none'

  // Resolve active visible columns with Refinement #3: Context-aware dynamic column pruning
  const visibleColSet = useMemo(() => {
    if (filters.cols && filters.cols.trim()) {
      return new Set(filters.cols.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean))
    }
    const defaultCols = new Set(['date', 'period', 'facility', 'class_batch', 'subject', 'experiment', 'teacher', 'attendance', 'status', 'remarks'])
    if (labId !== 'all') defaultCols.delete('facility')
    if (filters.subject_name && filters.subject_name !== 'all') defaultCols.delete('subject')
    if (filters.batch_group && filters.batch_group !== 'all') defaultCols.delete('class_batch')
    if (filters.teacher_id && filters.teacher_id !== 'all') defaultCols.delete('teacher')
    return defaultCols
  }, [filters.cols, labId, filters.subject_name, filters.batch_group, filters.teacher_id])

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      setLoading(true)
      try {
        let activeSelectedIds: string[] | undefined = undefined
        if (filters.selected) {
          activeSelectedIds = filters.selected.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        } else if (filters.selKey) {
          const tokenRes = await getPrintSelectionSessionAction(filters.selKey)
          if (tokenRes.success && tokenRes.ids.length > 0) {
            activeSelectedIds = tokenRes.ids
          }
        }
        setResolvedSelectedIds(activeSelectedIds)

        const res = await getPracticalRecords(
          {
            academic_year_id: academicYearId !== 'all' ? academicYearId : undefined,
            lab_id: labId,
            date_from: dateFrom,
            date_to: dateTo,
            status: filters.status as any,
            search: filters.search,
            batch_group: filters.batch_group,
            subject_name: filters.subject_name,
            teacher_id: filters.teacher_id,
            sortKey: filters.sortKey,
            sortDirection: filters.sortDirection,
            selected_ids: activeSelectedIds,
          },
          groupBy
        )
        if (res.success) {
          setSections(res.sections)
          setMetrics(res.metrics)
          if (res.academicYears) setAcademicYears(res.academicYears)
          if (res.activeAcademicYearId) setActiveAcademicYearId(res.activeAcademicYearId)
        }
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }
    loadData()
  }, [
    academicYearId,
    labId,
    dateFrom,
    dateTo,
    groupBy,
    filters.status,
    filters.search,
    filters.batch_group,
    filters.subject_name,
    filters.teacher_id,
    filters.selected,
    filters.selKey,
    filters.sortKey,
    filters.sortDirection,
  ])

  const scope = useMemo(() => {
    return resolveExportPrintScope({
      selectedIds: resolvedSelectedIds,
      isAllMatchingSelected: Boolean(filters.selectedAll),
      totalCount: metrics?.totalSessions || 0,
      filters,
      sortKey: filters.sortKey,
      sortDirection: filters.sortDirection,
    })
  }, [resolvedSelectedIds, filters, metrics])

  const labDisplayName =
    labId === 'comp'
      ? 'Computer Engineering Lab 01'
      : labId === 'phys'
      ? 'Physics Laboratory'
      : labId === 'chem'
      ? 'Chemistry Laboratory'
      : labId === 'bio'
      ? 'Biology & Life Sciences Lab'
      : labId === 'elec'
      ? 'Electronics & Hardware Lab'
      : 'All Laboratories (Consolidated)'

  const dateRangeLabel =
    dateFrom && dateTo
      ? `${dateFrom} to ${dateTo}`
      : dateFrom
      ? `From ${dateFrom}`
      : dateTo
      ? `Up to ${dateTo}`
      : 'All Academic Sessions'

  // Extract column specs
  const colDate = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'date')!
  const colPeriod = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'period_label')!
  const colBatch = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'batch_group')!
  const colSubject = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'subject_name')!
  const colExperiment = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'practical_title')!
  const colTeacher = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'teacher_name')!
  const colAttendance = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'attendance')!
  const colStatus = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'status')!
  const colRemarks = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'remarks')!

  // Dynamic footnote generation & word-boundary truncation
  const { computedSections, footnotes } = useMemo(() => {
    const notes: FootnoteEntry[] = []
    let rowCounter = 0

    const processed = sections.map((sec) => {
      const records = sec.records.map((log) => {
        rowCounter++
        const rowId = `Row #${rowCounter} (${log.date} | ${log.labs?.name || 'Lab'})`

        // Remarks / Skip Reason Truncation
        const rawRemarks =
          log.status === 'skipped'
            ? log.skip_reason
              ? `Skipped: ${log.skip_reason}`
              : 'Class postponed / holiday'
            : log.remarks || 'Standard practical routine executed.'

        let remarksDisplay = rawRemarks
        let remarksFootnoteIdx: number | null = null
        const maxRemarks = colRemarks.print[densityMode].maxChars
        const resRemarks = truncateAtWordBoundary(rawRemarks, maxRemarks)
        if (resRemarks.truncated) {
          const idx = notes.length + 1
          remarksFootnoteIdx = idx
          notes.push({
            index: idx,
            rowIdentifier: rowId,
            fieldName: log.status === 'skipped' ? 'Skip Reason' : 'Remarks',
            fullText: rawRemarks.trim(),
          })
          remarksDisplay = resRemarks.text
        }

        return {
          ...log,
          _remarksDisplay: remarksDisplay,
          _remarksFootnoteIdx: remarksFootnoteIdx,
        }
      })
      return {
        ...sec,
        records,
      }
    })

    return { computedSections: processed, footnotes: notes }
  }, [sections, densityMode, colRemarks])

  const headerAcademicYear = useMemo(() => {
    const formatAy = (name: string) => (name.includes('B.S.') ? name : `${name} (B.S.)`)
    if (academicYearId && academicYearId !== 'all') {
      const matched = academicYears.find((ay) => ay.id === academicYearId)
      return matched ? formatAy(matched.name) : formatAy(academicYearId)
    }
    if (activeAcademicYearId) {
      const active = academicYears.find((ay) => ay.id === activeAcademicYearId)
      if (active) return `All Cycles (Active: ${formatAy(active.name)})`
    }
    return `Academic Year: ${INSTITUTION_CONFIG.academicYear}`
  }, [academicYearId, academicYears, activeAcademicYearId])

  return (
    <PrintLayout
      icon={Printer}
      title="Official Practical Records Register"
      subtitle="A4 landscape report for practical logs, attendance, and signatures."
      backHref="/records"
      backLabel="Back to Records"
      printButtonLabel="Print Register (A4 Landscape)"
      printButtonColorClass="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700"
      densityMode={densityMode}
      onDensityModeChange={setDensityMode}
      headerFacilityName={labDisplayName}
      headerAcademicYear={headerAcademicYear}
      documentTitleBadge={
        academicYearId && academicYearId !== 'all'
          ? `OFFICIAL PRACTICAL EXPERIMENT & ATTENDANCE AUDIT REGISTER (ACADEMIC YEAR ${headerAcademicYear})`
          : `OFFICIAL PRACTICAL EXPERIMENT & ATTENDANCE AUDIT REGISTER (CONSOLIDATED AUDIT)`
      }
      signatureTier="2-tier"
      footerNote={scope.traceabilityNote}
      footnotes={footnotes}
      metadataGrid={
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 mb-4 text-xs font-sans print:grid-cols-4 print:gap-2 print:p-1.5 print:mb-2 print:bg-transparent print:border-y print:border-zinc-800 print:rounded-none print:text-[7.5pt]">
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[9.5px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Facility</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 text-sm print:text-[8pt] font-semibold">{labDisplayName}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[9.5px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Audit Period</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">{dateRangeLabel}</strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[9.5px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Conducted Sessions</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">
              {metrics ? `${metrics.conductedSessions} / ${metrics.totalSessions} Slots` : '...'}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-zinc-500 block font-mono text-[9.5px] uppercase print:text-[6.5pt] print:text-zinc-600">Student Attendance</span>
            <strong className="text-zinc-900 font-mono print:text-[8pt]">
              {metrics
                ? `${metrics.totalPresent} / ${metrics.totalEnrolled} (${metrics.averageAttendancePct.toFixed(1)}%)`
                : '...'}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-4 pt-1.5 border-t border-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 font-mono text-[10.5px] flex items-center justify-between print:col-span-4 print:pt-0.5 print:mt-0.5 print:border-t print:border-zinc-300 print:text-[7pt]">
            <span>{scope.traceabilityNote}</span>
            <span className="text-zinc-500">Report Scope: {scope.filterSummary}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      {/* Main Practical Records Table */}
      <div className="border border-zinc-900 rounded-md overflow-x-auto mb-6 print:border-0 print:m-0 print:rounded-none print:overflow-visible print-dense-table">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs print:text-[8.5pt]">
          <thead className="print:table-header-group">
            <tr className="bg-zinc-100 border-b border-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 uppercase font-mono font-bold text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] print:bg-zinc-200/90 print:border-b print:border-zinc-800 print:h-6">
              {visibleColSet.has('date') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colDate.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  DATE
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('period') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colPeriod.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  PERIOD
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('facility') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: '6%' }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  FACILITY
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('class_batch') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colBatch.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  CLASS
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('subject') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colSubject.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  SUBJECT
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('experiment') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colExperiment.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400"
                >
                  PRACTICALS
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('teacher') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colTeacher.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  SUBJECT TEACHER
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('attendance') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colAttendance.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 text-center whitespace-nowrap font-mono"
                >
                  ATTENDANCE
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('status') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colStatus.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-400 text-center whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  STATUS
                </th>
              )}
              {visibleColSet.has('remarks') && (
                <th
                  style={{ width: `${colRemarks.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%` }}
                  className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5"
                >
                  REMARK
                </th>
              )}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-300 print:divide-zinc-400">
            {computedSections.length === 0 || loading ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={Math.max(1, [
                  visibleColSet.has('date'),
                  visibleColSet.has('period'),
                  visibleColSet.has('facility'),
                  visibleColSet.has('class_batch'),
                  visibleColSet.has('subject'),
                  visibleColSet.has('experiment'),
                  visibleColSet.has('teacher'),
                  visibleColSet.has('attendance'),
                  visibleColSet.has('status'),
                  visibleColSet.has('remarks'),
                ].filter(Boolean).length)} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500 font-mono italic">
                  {loading ? 'Loading certified records...' : 'No practical records recorded for this filter selection.'}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              computedSections.map((sec) => {
                const totalCols = Math.max(1, [
                  visibleColSet.has('date'),
                  visibleColSet.has('period'),
                  visibleColSet.has('facility'),
                  visibleColSet.has('class_batch'),
                  visibleColSet.has('subject'),
                  visibleColSet.has('experiment'),
                  visibleColSet.has('teacher'),
                  visibleColSet.has('attendance'),
                  visibleColSet.has('status'),
                  visibleColSet.has('remarks'),
                ].filter(Boolean).length)

                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={sec.groupKey}>
                    {sec.groupKey !== 'all' && (
                      <tr className="bg-zinc-100/90 print:bg-zinc-200/80 font-mono text-[10.5px] print:text-[8pt] font-bold border-y border-zinc-400 print:border-zinc-600 break-inside-avoid print:break-inside-avoid">
                        <td colSpan={totalCols} className="py-1.5 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 text-zinc-900">
                          📂 GROUP: {sec.groupTitle.toUpperCase()} ({sec.subtotal.totalSessions} Sessions) — Attendance: {sec.subtotal.totalPresent}/{sec.subtotal.totalEnrolled} ({sec.subtotal.averageAttendancePct.toFixed(1)}%) | {sec.subtotal.conductedSessions} Conducted, {sec.subtotal.skippedSessions} Skipped
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}

                    {sec.records.map((log: any, idx: number) => {
                      const isSkipped = log.status === 'skipped'
                      const turnout =
                        log.total_students > 0
                          ? Math.round((log.present_students / log.total_students) * 100)
                          : 0

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={log.id || idx}
                          className="hover:bg-zinc-50/60 break-inside-avoid print:break-inside-avoid print:leading-[1.15]"
                        >
                          {/* 1. Date */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('date') && (() => {
                            const miti = formatToNepaliMiti(log.date)
                            return (
                              <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 font-mono font-medium align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                                {miti ? (
                                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                                    <span className="font-bold print:text-[8pt] text-zinc-900 font-heading">
                                      {miti.bsFormattedNp}
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="text-[9px] print:text-[6.5pt] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                                      {miti.adDateStr}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  log.date
                                )}
                              </td>
                            )
                          })()}

                          {/* 2. Period */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('period') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 font-mono text-[10.5px] print:text-[7pt] align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                              <div className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 leading-tight">
                                {log.period_label ? log.period_label.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/, '') : '—'}
                              </div>
                              {log.period_label && log.period_label.includes('(') && (
                                <div className="text-[9.5px] print:text-[6pt] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-0.5 leading-tight">
                                  {log.period_label.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/)?.[1]}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 3. Facility */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('facility') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top font-mono font-medium text-zinc-900 whitespace-nowrap text-[10.5px] print:text-[7.5pt]">
                              {formatFacilityShortCode(log.labs?.name || log.lab_id)}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 4. Class / Batch */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('class_batch') && (
                            <td
                              className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top font-semibold text-zinc-900 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10.5px] print:text-[7.5pt]"
                              title={log.batch_group || undefined}
                            >
                              {formatClassCode(log.batch_group)}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 5. Subject */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('subject') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 print:py-0.5 print:px-1 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top text-zinc-950 font-mono font-bold text-[10.5px] print:text-[8pt] whitespace-nowrap">
                              {cleanSubjectCode(log.subject_code, log.subject_name)}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 6. Practicals */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('experiment') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top text-zinc-900 font-medium text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] leading-snug">
                              {cleanPracticalTitle(log.practical_title)}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 7. Subject Teacher */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('teacher') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 align-top font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                              {log.profiles?.full_name || 'Assigned Subject Teacher'}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 8. Attendance */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('attendance') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 text-center font-mono align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                              {isSkipped ? (
                                <span className="text-zinc-400 font-mono text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt]">N/A</span>
                              ) : (
                                <div>
                                  <span className="font-bold">{log.present_students}</span>
                                  <span className="text-zinc-500">/{log.total_students}</span>
                                  <div className="text-[10px] print:text-[7.5pt] text-zinc-600 font-mono font-bold">
                                    {turnout}%
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 9. Status */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('status') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 border-r border-zinc-300 print:border-zinc-300 text-center align-top whitespace-nowrap">
                              {isSkipped ? (
                                <span className="text-amber-800 font-bold uppercase text-[9.5px] print:text-[7.5pt] bg-amber-50 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-amber-300">
                                  Skipped
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-emerald-800 font-bold uppercase text-[9.5px] print:text-[7.5pt] bg-emerald-50 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-emerald-300">
                                  Done
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          )}

                          {/* 10. Remarks */}
                          {visibleColSet.has('remarks') && (
                            <td className="py-2 px-2.5 print:py-0.5 print:px-1.5 align-top text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] text-zinc-700">
                              {isSkipped ? (
                                <span className="text-amber-900 italic font-medium">
                                  {log._remarksDisplay}
                                  {log._remarksFootnoteIdx && (
                                    <sup className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 print:text-zinc-950 ml-0.5">
                                      [{log._remarksFootnoteIdx}]
                                    </sup>
                                  )}
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span>
                                  {log._remarksDisplay}
                                  {log._remarksFootnoteIdx && (
                                    <sup className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 print:text-zinc-950 ml-0.5">
                                      [{log._remarksFootnoteIdx}]
                                    </sup>
                                  )}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          )}
                        </tr>
                      )
                    })}
                  </React.Fragment>
                )
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </PrintLayout>
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { Metadata } from 'next'
import { getLabSeatPlan } from '@/app/actions/seat-plans'
import { getAuthorizedClasses } from '@/app/actions/seat-plans'
import { getAcademicYears } from '@/app/actions/academic-years'
import PrintSeatingChartView from '@/components/computer-lab/print-seating-chart-view'
import type { CohortSeatPlanData } from '@/lib/types/seat-plans'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Official Laboratory Seating Wall Chart | Print Sheet',
  description: 'Certified A4 landscape laboratory workstation seating chart and student roster for door mounting',
}

interface PrintSeatingChartPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    lab_id?: string
    class_id?: string
    academic_year_id?: string
  }>
}

export default async function PrintSeatingChartPage({ searchParams }: PrintSeatingChartPageProps) {
  const params = await searchParams
  const labId = params.lab_id || 'comp'
  const classId = params.class_id || '12eng'
  const yearId = params.academic_year_id || '2083'

  const [planRes, classesRes, yearsRes] = await Promise.all([
    getLabSeatPlan({ labId, classId, academicYearId: yearId }),
    getAuthorizedClasses(),
    getAcademicYears(),
  ])

  const planData: CohortSeatPlanData = planRes.success && planRes.data ? planRes.data : {
    lab_id: labId,
    lab_name: 'Computer Engineering Lab 01',
    academic_year_id: yearId,
    academic_year_name: '2083 BS',
    class_id: classId,
    class_name: 'Class 12 Science (Computer)',
    total_students: 0,
    assigned_count: 0,
    unassigned_count: 0,
    workstations: [],
    unassigned_students: [],
  }

  const currentClass = classesRes.success && classesRes.data
    ? classesRes.data.find((c) => c.id === classId)?.name || 'Class 12 Science (Computer)'
    : 'Class 12 Science (Computer)'

  const currentYear = yearsRes.success && yearsRes.data
    ? yearsRes.data.find((y) => y.id === yearId)?.name || '2083 BS'
    : '2083 BS'

  return (
    <PrintSeatingChartView
      data={planData}
      classNameDisplay={currentClass}
      academicYearDisplay={currentYear}
      labDisplayName="Computer Engineering Lab 01"
    />
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, useTransition } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  ClipboardList,
  AlertTriangle,
  Sparkles,
  Printer,
  ShieldCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  Plus,
} from 'lucide-react'
import {
  PracticalGroupedSection,
  PracticalRecordFilters,
  PracticalGroupingKey,
  PracticalSummaryMetrics,
} from '@/types/records'
import { getPracticalRecords } from '@/app/actions/records'
import { getActiveLabs, getTeachers } from '@/app/actions/logs'
import { filtersToSearchParams, searchParamsToFilters } from '@/lib/report-spec/filter-codec'
import PracticalSummaryStrip from '@/components/records/practical-summary-strip'
import PracticalFilterBar from '@/components/records/practical-filter-bar'
import PracticalRecordsTable from '@/components/records/practical-records-table'
import SyllabusProgress from '@/components/dashboard/syllabus-progress'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import PageHeader from '@/components/layout/page-header'

export default function PracticalRecordsPage() {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<PracticalGroupedSection[]>([])
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<PracticalSummaryMetrics>({
    totalSessions: 0,
    conductedSessions: 0,
    skippedSessions: 0,
    totalPresent: 0,
    totalEnrolled: 0,
    averageAttendancePct: 0,
  })
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(0)
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1)
  const [userRole, setUserRole] = useState<string>('teacher')
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState<string>('')
  const [userScope, setUserScope] = useState<any>(null)
  const [labs, setLabs] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string }>>([])
  const [teachers, setTeachers] = useState<Array<{ id: string; full_name: string }>>([])
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; isCurrent: boolean }>>([])
  const [activeAcademicYearId, setActiveAcademicYearId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Filters and Grouping State (initialized with defaults or URL params if in browser)
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<PracticalRecordFilters>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.search) {
      const parsed = searchParamsToFilters(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search))
      return {
        academic_year_id: parsed.academic_year_id || 'all',
        lab_id: parsed.lab_id || 'all',
        batch_group: parsed.batch_group || 'all',
        subject_name: parsed.subject_name || 'all',
        teacher_id: parsed.teacher_id || 'all',
        status: parsed.status || 'all',
        search: parsed.search || '',
        page: parsed.page || 1,
        pageSize: parsed.pageSize || 10,
        sortKey: parsed.sortKey,
        sortDirection: parsed.sortDirection,
        date_from: parsed.date_from || '',
        date_to: parsed.date_to || '',
        date: parsed.date || '',
        period_label: parsed.period_label || '',
        remarks: parsed.remarks || '',
        teacher_name: parsed.teacher_name || '',
      }
    }
    return {
      academic_year_id: 'all',
      lab_id: 'all',
      batch_group: 'all',
      subject_name: 'all',
      teacher_id: 'all',
      status: 'all',
      search: '',
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 10,
    }
  })
  const [groupBy, setGroupBy] = useState<PracticalGroupingKey>('none')

  // Initial load of master labs and teachers
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadMasterData() {
      try {
        const [activeLabs, activeTeachers] = await Promise.all([
          getActiveLabs(),
          getTeachers(),
        ])
        setLabs(activeLabs)
        setTeachers(activeTeachers)
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Failed to load labs/teachers:', err)
      }
    }
    loadMasterData()
  }, [])

  // Fetch records whenever filters or grouping change
  const fetchRecords = () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getPracticalRecords(filters, groupBy)
        if (res.success) {
          setSections(res.sections)
          setMetrics(res.metrics)
          setTotalCount(res.totalCount)
          setTotalPages(res.totalPages || 1)
          setUserRole(res.userRole)
          if (res.userName) setUserName(res.userName)
          if (res.userScope) setUserScope(res.userScope)
          if (res.academicYears) setAcademicYears(res.academicYears)
          if (res.activeAcademicYearId) setActiveAcademicYearId(res.activeAcademicYearId)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching practical records:', err)
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false)
      }
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchRecords()

      // Sync URL search params with current filters without reloading
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const params = filtersToSearchParams({
          ...filters,
          groupBy: groupBy !== 'none' ? groupBy : undefined,
        })
        const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}?${params.toString()}`
        window.history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl)
      }
    }, 300)

    return () => clearTimeout(handler)
  }, [filters, groupBy])

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: Partial<PracticalRecordFilters>) => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...newFilters,
    }))
  }

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setFilters({
      academic_year_id: 'all',
      lab_id: 'all',
      batch_group: 'all',
      subject_name: 'all',
      teacher_id: 'all',
      status: 'all',
      search: '',
      date_from: '',
      date_to: '',
      date: '',
      period_label: '',
      remarks: '',
      teacher_name: '',
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 10,
    })
    setGroupBy('none')
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 w-full pb-16 font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Unified Page Header */}
      <PageHeader
        title="Practical Records & Verification"
        subtitle="Verified practical experiment logs, attendance, and syllabus tracking"
        icon={ClipboardList}
        iconColor="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-200/60 dark:border-emerald-800/60"
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: 'Practical Records' }]}
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Link href="/records/new">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-sans text-xs font-semibold gap-1.5 shadow-xs border border-emerald-500/30 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Record Practical</span>
              </Button>
            </Link>

            <Link href="/records/incidents">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-mono font-medium hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 gap-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" />
                <span>Incident Register</span>
              </Button>
            </Link>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={fetchRecords}
              disabled={isPending}
              className="h-9 px-3 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${isPending ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {/* Module C: Analytics Summary Strip */}
      <PracticalSummaryStrip metrics={metrics} isLoading={isLoading || isPending} />

      {/* Curriculum Syllabus Progress & Quota Tracking */}
      <SyllabusProgress />

      {/* Module A1: Filter and Grouping Bar */}
      <PracticalFilterBar
        filters={filters}
        groupBy={groupBy}
        onFiltersChange={setFilters}
        onGroupByChange={setGroupBy}
        onReset={handleResetFilters}
        labs={labs}
        teachers={teachers}
        academicYears={academicYears}
        activeAcademicYearId={activeAcademicYearId}
        userRole={userRole}
        userName={userName}
        userScope={userScope}
      />

      {/* Module A1 & A2: Filterable, Segmentable Table with Grouping, Actions & Exports */}
      <PracticalRecordsTable
        sections={sections}
        filters={filters}
        groupBy={groupBy}
        totalCount={totalCount}
        page={filters.page || 1}
        pageSize={filters.pageSize || 10}
        totalPages={totalPages}
        onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
        userRole={userRole}
        userName={userName}
        userScope={userScope}
        onRecordUpdated={fetchRecords}
        isLoading={isLoading || isPending}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useTransition } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ClipboardList,
  RefreshCw,
  Plus,
  ShieldCheck,
} from 'lucide-react'
import {
  IncidentRecordItem,
  IncidentRecordFilters,
  IncidentSummaryMetrics,
} from '@/types/records'
import { getIncidentRecords } from '@/app/actions/records'
import { getActiveLabs } from '@/app/actions/logs'
import { filtersToSearchParams, searchParamsToFilters } from '@/lib/report-spec/filter-codec'
import IncidentSummaryStrip from '@/components/records/incident-summary-strip'
import IncidentFilterBar from '@/components/records/incident-filter-bar'
import IncidentRecordsTable from '@/components/records/incident-records-table'
import IncidentDetailDrawer from '@/components/records/incident-detail-drawer'
import ReportIncidentModal from '@/components/dashboard/report-incident-modal'
import PageHeader from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

export default function IncidentRecordsPage() {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<IncidentRecordItem[]>([])
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<IncidentSummaryMetrics>({
    totalIncidents: 0,
    openCount: 0,
    resolvedCount: 0,
    underRepairCount: 0,
    replacedCount: 0,
    escalatedCount: 0,
    minorCount: 0,
    moderateCount: 0,
    criticalCount: 0,
    averageTimeToResolveHours: null,
    averageTimeToResolveLabel: 'N/A',
  })
  const [userRole, setUserRole] = useState<string>('teacher')
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string>('')
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(0)
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1)
  const [labs, setLabs] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string }>>([])
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; isCurrent: boolean }>>([])
  const [activeAcademicYearId, setActiveAcademicYearId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Modal and Drawer States
  const [selectedIncident, setSelectedIncident] = useState<IncidentRecordItem | null>(null)
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isReportModalOpen, setIsReportModalOpen] = useState(false)

  // Filters State
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<IncidentRecordFilters>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.search) {
      const parsed = searchParamsToFilters(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search))
      return {
        academic_year_id: (parsed as any).academic_year_id || 'all',
        lab_id: parsed.lab_id || 'all',
        severity: parsed.severity || 'all',
        status: parsed.status || 'all',
        incident_type: (parsed as any).incident_type || 'all',
        date_from: parsed.date_from || '',
        date_to: parsed.date_to || '',
        date: parsed.date || '',
        equipment_name: parsed.equipment_name || '',
        title: parsed.title || '',
        teacher_name: parsed.teacher_name || '',
        search: parsed.search || '',
        page: parsed.page || 1,
        pageSize: parsed.pageSize || 10,
        sortKey: parsed.sortKey,
        sortDirection: parsed.sortDirection,
      }
    }
    return {
      academic_year_id: 'all',
      lab_id: 'all',
      severity: 'all',
      status: 'all',
      incident_type: 'all',
      search: '',
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 10,
    }
  })

  // Format a raw or client incident into an IncidentRecordItem
  const formatIncidentItem = (raw: any): IncidentRecordItem => {
    return {
      id: raw.id,
      lab_id: raw.lab_id,
      schedule_id: raw.schedule_id || null,
      date: raw.date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      session_label: raw.session_label || 'Practical Session',
      subject_name: raw.subject_name || 'Laboratory Session',
      subject_teacher_name: raw.subject_teacher_name || raw.reported_by || 'Faculty In-Charge',
      batch_name: raw.batch_name || 'Class Practical',
      title: raw.title,
      circumstances: raw.circumstances || null,
      photo_url: raw.photo_url || null,
      incident_type: raw.incident_type || 'breakage',
      severity: raw.severity || 'minor',
      equipment_name: raw.equipment_name || 'Equipment',
      quantity: raw.quantity || 1,
      student_rolls: raw.student_rolls || null,
      status: raw.status || 'reported',
      escalated_to_hod: Boolean(raw.escalated_to_hod),
      escalation_reason: raw.escalation_reason || null,
      escalated_at: raw.escalated_at || null,
      resolution_notes: raw.resolution_notes || null,
      resolved_by: raw.resolved_by || null,
      resolved_by_id: raw.resolved_by_id || null,
      resolved_at: raw.resolved_at || null,
      reported_by: raw.reported_by || 'Faculty In-Charge',
      reported_by_id: raw.reported_by_id || null,
      is_fined: Boolean(raw.is_fined),
      fine_amount: raw.fine_amount || 0,
      fine_paid: Boolean(raw.fine_paid),
      fine_receipt_no: raw.fine_receipt_no || null,
      created_at: raw.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      labs: raw.labs || {
        id: raw.lab_id,
        name:
          raw.lab_id === 'chem'
            ? 'Chemistry Laboratory'
            : raw.lab_id === 'phys'
            ? 'Physics Laboratory'
            : raw.lab_id === 'comp'
            ? 'Computer Engineering Lab 01'
            : `${String(raw.lab_id).toUpperCase()} Lab`,
        type: `${raw.lab_id}_lab`,
      },
      time_to_resolve_label:
        raw.time_to_resolve_label ||
        (raw.status === 'resolved'
          ? 'Resolved'
          : raw.status === 'under_repair'
          ? 'Under Repair'
          : raw.status === 'replaced'
          ? 'Replaced'
          : raw.status === 'escalated_to_hod'
          ? 'Escalated to HOD'
          : 'Active / Open'),
      time_to_resolve_hours: raw.time_to_resolve_hours || null,
    }
  }

  // Merge server data with any optimistic / pending items in localStorage
  const reconcileWithLocalStorage = (serverIncidents: IncidentRecordItem[], serverMetrics?: IncidentSummaryMetrics) => {
    try {
      const savedRaw = localStorage.getItem('lab_incidents_v1')
      const outboxRaw = localStorage.getItem('lab_pending_incidents_outbox_v1')
      const localMap = new Map<string, any>()

      if (savedRaw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedRaw)
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          parsed.forEach((item) => {
            if (item && item.id) localMap.set(item.id, item)
          })
        }
      }
      if (outboxRaw) {
        const parsedOutbox = JSON.parse(outboxRaw)
        if (Array.isArray(parsedOutbox)) {
          parsedOutbox.forEach((item) => {
            if (item && item.id) localMap.set(item.id, item)
          })
        }
      }

      if (localMap.size > 0) {
        const serverIds = new Set(serverIncidents.map((i) => i.id))
        const missingLocal: IncidentRecordItem[] = []
        localMap.forEach((item, id) => {
          if (!serverIds.has(id)) {
            missingLocal.push(formatIncidentItem(item))
          }
        })

        if (missingLocal.length > 0) {
          const seen = new Set<string>()
          const merged: IncidentRecordItem[] = []
          for (const item of [...missingLocal, ...serverIncidents]) {
            if (item && item.id && !seen.has(item.id)) {
              seen.add(item.id)
              merged.push(item)
            }
          }
          setIncidents(merged)
          if (serverMetrics) {
            setMetrics({
              ...serverMetrics,
              totalIncidents: serverMetrics.totalIncidents + missingLocal.length,
              openCount: serverMetrics.openCount + missingLocal.filter((i) => i.status !== 'resolved').length,
            })
          }
          return
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const dedupedServer: IncidentRecordItem[] = []
    for (const item of serverIncidents) {
      if (item && item.id && !seen.has(item.id)) {
        seen.add(item.id)
        dedupedServer.push(item)
      }
    }
    setIncidents(dedupedServer)
    if (serverMetrics) setMetrics(serverMetrics)
  }

  // Initial load of master labs
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadMasterData() {
      try {
        const labsData = await getActiveLabs()
        setLabs(labsData)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching master labs:', err)
      }
    }
    loadMasterData()
  }, [])

  const fetchIncidents = (showLoader = true) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      if (showLoader) setIsLoading(true)
      try {
        const res = await getIncidentRecords(filters)
        if (res.success) {
          reconcileWithLocalStorage(res.incidents, res.metrics)
          setTotalCount(res.totalCount || res.incidents.length)
          setTotalPages(res.totalPages || 1)
          setUserRole(res.userRole)
          if (res.userId) setUserId(res.userId)
          if (res.academicYears) setAcademicYears(res.academicYears)
          if (res.activeAcademicYearId) setActiveAcademicYearId(res.activeAcademicYearId)
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching incident records:', err)
      } finally {
        if (showLoader) setIsLoading(false)
      }
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchIncidents(true)

      // Sync URL search params with current filters without reloading
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const params = filtersToSearchParams(filters)
        const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}?${params.toString()}`
        window.history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl)
      }
    }, 300)

    return () => clearTimeout(handler)
  }, [filters])

  const handleFiltersChange = (newFilters: Partial<IncidentRecordFilters>) => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...newFilters,
    }))
  }

  // Reactive listeners for instant cross-component and cross-tab synchronization
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleIncidentEvent = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<{
        action?: string
        incidentId?: string
        incident?: any
        updates?: any
      }>
      const detail = customEvent?.detail

      if (detail?.incident && (detail.action === 'created' || !detail.action)) {
        const formatted = formatIncidentItem(detail.incident)
        setIncidents((prev) => {
          const filtered = prev.filter((i) => i.id !== formatted.id)
          return [formatted, ...filtered]
        })
        setMetrics((m) => ({
          ...m,
          totalIncidents: m.totalIncidents + 1,
          openCount: m.openCount + 1,
          minorCount: detail.incident.severity === 'minor' ? m.minorCount + 1 : m.minorCount,
          moderateCount: detail.incident.severity === 'moderate' ? m.moderateCount + 1 : m.moderateCount,
          criticalCount: detail.incident.severity === 'major_critical' ? m.criticalCount + 1 : m.criticalCount,
        }))
      } else if (detail?.incidentId && detail?.updates) {
        setIncidents((prev) =>
          prev.map((i) => (i.id === detail.incidentId ? { ...i, ...detail.updates } : i))
        )
      }

      // Seamless background reconciliation without flickering the loader
      getIncidentRecords(filters).then((res) => {
        if (res.success) {
          reconcileWithLocalStorage(res.incidents, res.metrics)
        }
      }).catch(() => {})
    }

    window.addEventListener('incidents-updated', handleIncidentEvent)
    window.addEventListener('new-incident-broadcast', handleIncidentEvent)

    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'lab_incidents_v1' || e.key === 'lab_pending_incidents_outbox_v1') {
        fetchIncidents(false)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage)

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('incidents-updated', handleIncidentEvent)
      window.removeEventListener('new-incident-broadcast', handleIncidentEvent)
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage)
    }
  }, [filters])

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setFilters({
      academic_year_id: 'all',
      lab_id: 'all',
      severity: 'all',
      status: 'all',
      incident_type: 'all',
      search: '',
      date_from: '',
      date_to: '',
      date: '',
      equipment_name: '',
      title: '',
      teacher_name: '',
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 10,
    })
  }

  const handleSelectIncident = (inc: IncidentRecordItem) => {
    setSelectedIncident(inc)
    setIsDrawerOpen(true)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 w-full pb-16 font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <PageHeader
        title="Laboratory Incident & Damage Register"
        subtitle="Equipment breakages, repair progress, and escalation records"
        icon={AlertTriangle}
        iconColor="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border-indigo-200/60 dark:border-indigo-800/60"
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: 'Practical Records', href: '/records' },
          { label: 'Incident Register' },
        ]}
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Link href="/records">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-mono font-medium hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 gap-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ClipboardList className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Practical Records</span>
              </Button>
            </Link>

            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setIsReportModalOpen(true)}
              className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold gap-1.5 shadow-xs transition-transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Report Damage</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => fetchIncidents(true)}
              disabled={isPending || isLoading}
              className="h-9 w-9 p-0 rounded-xl border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 cursor-pointer"
              title="Refresh Incident Registry"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {/* Module C: Analytics Summary Strip */}
      <IncidentSummaryStrip metrics={metrics} isLoading={isLoading || isPending} />

      {/* Module B1: Filter Bar */}
      <IncidentFilterBar
        filters={filters}
        onFiltersChange={setFilters}
        onReset={handleResetFilters}
        labs={labs}
        academicYears={academicYears}
      />

      {/* Module B1 & B3: Table */}
      <IncidentRecordsTable
        incidents={incidents}
        filters={filters}
        onSelectIncident={handleSelectIncident}
        totalCount={totalCount}
        page={filters.page || 1}
        pageSize={filters.pageSize || 10}
        totalPages={totalPages}
        onFiltersChange={handleFiltersChange}
        labs={labs}
        userRole={userRole}
        userName={userId}
        isLoading={isLoading || isPending}
      />

      {/* Module B2: Incident Detail & Action Drawer */}
      <IncidentDetailDrawer
        incident={selectedIncident}
        isOpen={isDrawerOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsDrawerOpen(false)
          setSelectedIncident(null)
        }}
        onSuccess={fetchIncidents}
        userRole={userRole}
      />

      {/* Report Incident Modal */}
      <ReportIncidentModal
        isOpen={isReportModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsReportModalOpen(false)}
        defaultLabId="phys"
        onSuccess={() => {
          fetchIncidents()
          setIsReportModalOpen(false)
        }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
