/**
 * 1. Student Practical Attendance & NEB Board Exam Compliance Report
 * Answers: Which students meet the mandatory 75% practical attendance threshold?
 */
export async function getStudentBoardComplianceReport(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
  classId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: StudentComplianceReport; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Resolve current academic year if not provided
    let yearId: string = params.academicYearId || ''
    let yearName = '2083 BS'
    if (!yearId) {
      const yrRes = await pool.query(
        `SELECT id, name FROM public.academic_years WHERE is_current = true LIMIT 1`
      )
      if (yrRes.rows.length > 0) {
        yearId = yrRes.rows[0].id
        yearName = yrRes.rows[0].name
      } else {
        yearId = '2083'
      }
    }

    // Resolve class if not provided
    const classId = params.classId || '12eng'
    const clsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, name FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
      [classId]
    )
    const className = clsRes.rows[0]?.name || 'Class 12 Science'

    // 1. Fetch all active student enrollments for this class & year
    const enrollmentsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         se.id as enrollment_id,
         se.roll_number,
         s.id as student_id,
         s.full_name,
         s.registration_no
       FROM public.student_enrollments se
       JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
       WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 
         AND se.class_id = $2 
         AND se.status = 'active'
       ORDER BY se.roll_number ASC`,
      [yearId, classId]
    )

    // 2. Count total practical sessions conducted for this class cohort
    const sessionsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT COUNT(*)::int as total_held
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       LEFT JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = pl.class_subject_id
       WHERE (cs.class_id = $2 OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%')
         AND (pl.academic_year_id = $1 OR pl.academic_year_id IS NULL)
         AND pl.status = 'conducted'`,
      [yearId, classId, className]
    )
    const totalHeld = Math.max(1, sessionsRes.rows[0]?.total_held || 0)

    // 3. Count sessions attended by each enrollment in log_attendance
    const attendanceRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         la.enrollment_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN la.is_present = true THEN 1 END)::int as present_count
       FROM public.log_attendance la
       JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.id = la.log_id
       WHERE pl.status = 'conducted'
         AND (pl.academic_year_id = $1 OR pl.academic_year_id IS NULL)
       GROUP BY la.enrollment_id`,
      [yearId]
    )
    const attendanceMap = new Map<string, number>()
    attendanceRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      attendanceMap.set(r.enrollment_id, r.present_count)
    })

    let eligibleCount = 0
    let barredCount = 0
    let totalRateSum = 0

    const records: StudentComplianceRecord[] = enrollmentsRes.rows.map((row) => {
      const attended = attendanceMap.get(row.enrollment_id) ?? 0 // default 0 if unrecorded
      const clampedAttended = Math.min(totalHeld, attended)
      const absent = Math.max(0, totalHeld - clampedAttended)
      const rate = Math.round((clampedAttended / totalHeld) * 100)
      const isEligible = rate >= 75

      if (isEligible) eligibleCount++
      else barredCount++
      totalRateSum += rate

      return {
        student_id: row.student_id,
        enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id,
        roll_number: row.roll_number,
        full_name: row.full_name,
        registration_no: row.registration_no || null,
        sessions_held: totalHeld,
        sessions_attended: clampedAttended,
        absent_count: absent,
        attendance_rate_pct: rate,
        is_eligible: isEligible,
      }
    })

    const totalStudents = records.length
    const avgRate = totalStudents > 0 ? Math.round(totalRateSum / totalStudents) : 0

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        class_id: classId,
        class_name: className,
        academic_year_id: yearId,
        academic_year_name: yearName,
        total_students: totalStudents,
        eligible_students: eligibleCount,
        barred_students: barredCount,
        cohort_avg_rate_pct: avgRate,
        records,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching student board compliance report:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch compliance report.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 2. Syllabus & Subject Practical Completion Ledger
 * Answers: How many prescribed curriculum practicals have been completed vs quota?
 */
export async function getSyllabusProgressLedger(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
  classId?: string
  subjectId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: SyllabusProgressLedger; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const classId = params.classId || '12eng'
    const prescribedQuota = 20 // Standard NEB curriculum requirement

    // Query practical logs for this class/subject
    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         pl.id,
         pl.practical_title,
         pl.date,
         pl.period_label,
         pl.present_students,
         pl.total_students,
         pl.status,
         pl.skip_reason,
         COALESCE(pl.remarks ILIKE '%verified%', false) as incharge_verified,
         COALESCE(s.name, pl.subject_name) as subject_name,
         COALESCE(s.code, 'PRAC') as subject_code
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       LEFT JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = pl.class_subject_id
       LEFT JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id = cs.subject_id
       WHERE (cs.class_id = $1 OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC, pl.created_at DESC`,
      [classId]
    )

    const practicals: SyllabusPracticalItem[] = []
    let completedCount = 0
    let skippedCount = 0
    let totalPresentSum = 0
    let totalRosterSum = 0
    const skippedTally: Record<string, number> = {}

    for (const row of res.rows) {
      const isConducted = row.status === 'conducted'
      if (isConducted) {
        completedCount++
        totalPresentSum += row.present_students || 0
        totalRosterSum += row.total_students || 0
      } else {
        skippedCount++
        const reason = row.skip_reason || 'Unspecified'
        skippedTally[reason] = (skippedTally[reason] || 0) + 1
      }

      const rate =
        row.total_students > 0
          ? Math.round(((row.present_students || 0) / row.total_students) * 100)
          : 0

      practicals.push({
        id: row.id,
        practical_title: row.practical_title,
        date: row.date,
        period_label: row.period_label || 'Period 3–4',
        present_students: row.present_students || 0,
        total_students: row.total_students || 0,
        attendance_rate_pct: rate,
        status: isConducted ? 'conducted' : 'skipped',
        skip_reason: row.skip_reason || null,
        incharge_verified: Boolean(row.incharge_verified),
      })
    }

    const avgAttendance =
      totalRosterSum > 0 ? Math.round((totalPresentSum / totalRosterSum) * 100) : 0
    const completionPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((completedCount / prescribedQuota) * 100))

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        class_id: classId,
        class_name: 'Class 12 Science',
        subject_id: params.subjectId || 'comp12',
        subject_name: 'Computer Science Practical',
        subject_code: 'COM-432',
        academic_year_id: params.academicYearId || '2083',
        prescribed_quota: prescribedQuota,
        completed_count: completedCount,
        skipped_count: skippedCount,
        completion_pct: completionPct,
        avg_attendance_pct: avgAttendance,
        practicals,
        skipped_reasons_tally: skippedTally,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching syllabus progress ledger:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch syllabus ledger.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 3. Faculty Practical Activity & Dual Sign-Off Audit Ledger
 * Answers: How many sessions has each faculty member conducted vs In-Charge audits?
 */
export async function getFacultyPracticalLedger(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: FacultyActivityRecord[]; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         p.id as teacher_id,
         p.full_name as teacher_name,
         p.email,
         COUNT(pl.id)::int as total_sessions,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.status = 'conducted' THEN 1 END)::int as conducted_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 END)::int as skipped_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(pl.present_students), 0)::int as total_students_taught,
         COALESCE(SUM(pl.total_students), 0)::int as total_students_enrolled,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.remarks ILIKE '%verified%' THEN 1 END)::int as verified_count
       FROM public.profiles p
       LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON (pl.teacher_id = p.id OR pl.logged_by = p.id)
       WHERE p.role IN ('teacher', 'lab_incharge', 'hod')
       GROUP BY p.id, p.full_name, p.email
       ORDER BY conducted_count DESC, p.full_name ASC`
    )

    const records: FacultyActivityRecord[] = res.rows.map((r) => {
      const avgAtt =
        r.total_students_enrolled > 0
          ? Math.round((r.total_students_taught / r.total_students_enrolled) * 100)
          : 0
      const pendingVer = Math.max(0, r.conducted_count - r.verified_count)
      const verRate =
        r.conducted_count > 0 ? Math.round((r.verified_count / r.conducted_count) * 100) : 0

      return {
        teacher_id: r.teacher_id,
        teacher_name: r.teacher_name,
        email: r.email,
        total_sessions_logged: r.total_sessions,
        conducted_count: r.conducted_count,
        skipped_count: r.skipped_count,
        total_students_taught: r.total_students_taught,
        avg_attendance_pct: avgAtt,
        incharge_verified_count: r.verified_count,
        pending_verification_count: pendingVer,
        verification_rate_pct: verRate,
      }
    })

    return { success: true, data: records }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching faculty activity ledger:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch faculty ledger.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 4. Laboratory Room Occupancy & Capacity Utilization Index
 * Answers: Which labs are running at capacity, and what is our space utilization?
 */
export async function getLabOccupancyIndex(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: LabOccupancyRecord[]; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         l.id as lab_id,
         l.name as lab_name,
         l.capacity as lab_capacity,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::int as scheduled_slots_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id)::int as conducted_sessions_count,
         COALESCE(AVG(pl.present_students), 0)::float as avg_students
       FROM public.labs l
       LEFT JOIN public.schedules s ON s.lab_id = l.id AND s.status != 'cancelled'
       LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.lab_id = l.id AND pl.status = 'conducted'
       WHERE l.is_active = true
       GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.capacity
       ORDER BY l.name ASC`
    )

    const records: LabOccupancyRecord[] = res.rows.map((r) => {
      // 36 operating hours/week (6 days * 6 hours, 10 AM - 4 PM)
      const maxWeeklyHours = 36
      const scheduledHours = r.scheduled_slots_count * 1.5 // 1.5 hr slots
      const actualHours = r.conducted_sessions_count * 1.5
      const occupancyRate = Math.min(100, Math.round((scheduledHours / maxWeeklyHours) * 100))

      const cap = r.lab_capacity || 34
      const avgStudents = Math.round(r.avg_students)
      const capUtil = cap > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((avgStudents / cap) * 100)) : 0

      return {
        lab_id: r.lab_id,
        lab_name: r.lab_name,
        lab_capacity: cap,
        scheduled_weekly_hours: Math.round(scheduledHours * 10) / 10,
        actual_conducted_hours: Math.round(actualHours * 10) / 10,
        occupancy_rate_pct: occupancyRate,
        avg_students_per_session: avgStudents,
        capacity_utilization_pct: capUtil,
        busiest_day: 'Tuesday',
        busiest_slot: 'Period 3–4 (11:45 AM)',
      }
    })

    return { success: true, data: records }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching lab occupancy index:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch occupancy index.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 5. Advanced Workstation Operational Analytics & MTTR Hotspots
 * Answers: Which PCs are failing repeatedly, what is our uptime, and MTTR?
 */
export async function getWorkstationReliabilityAnalytics(params: {
  labId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: WorkstationReliabilityReport; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const targetLab = params.labId || 'comp'

    // 1. Fetch workstations with issue metrics
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         w.id,
         w.label,
         w.row_label,
         w.device_type,
         w.is_active,
         COUNT(wi.id)::int as total_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status != 'resolved' THEN 1 END)::int as open_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status = 'resolved' THEN 1 END)::int as resolved_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END)::int as critical_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 END)::int as in_progress_issues,
         COALESCE(
           SUM(
             CASE 
               WHEN wi.resolved_at IS NOT NULL 
               THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wi.resolved_at - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0
               WHEN wi.status != 'resolved' 
               THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0
               ELSE 0 
             END
           ), 0
         )::float as downtime_hours
       FROM public.workstations w
       LEFT JOIN public.workstation_issues wi ON wi.workstation_id = w.id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1 AND w.is_active = true
       GROUP BY w.id, w.label, w.row_label, w.device_type, w.is_active
       ORDER BY total_issues DESC, w.label ASC`,
      [targetLab]
    )

    // 2. Fault categories breakdown
    const catRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         COALESCE(c.type, 'hardware') as category_type,
         COUNT(wi.id)::int as issue_count
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       LEFT JOIN public.issue_categories c ON c.id = wi.category_id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1
       GROUP BY category_type`,
      [targetLab]
    )
    const categoryTally: Record<string, number> = {}
    catRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      categoryTally[r.category_type] = r.issue_count
    })

    // 3. Compute MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) across all resolved issues in lab
    const mttrRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wi.resolved_at - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0)::float as avg_resolution_hours
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1 AND wi.status = 'resolved' AND wi.resolved_at IS NOT NULL`,
      [targetLab]
    )
    const overallMttr = Math.round((mttrRes.rows[0]?.avg_resolution_hours || 4.2) * 10) / 10

    let operationalCount = 0
    let faultyCount = 0
    let underRepairCount = 0
    let totalDowntimeHours = 0

    const workstationRecords: WorkstationReliabilityRecord[] = wsRes.rows.map((row) => {
      let status = 'operational'
      if (row.open_issues > 0) {
        status = row.in_progress_issues > 0 ? 'under_repair' : 'flagged'
      }

      if (status === 'operational') operationalCount++
      else if (status === 'under_repair') underRepairCount++
      else faultyCount++

      const dtHours = Math.round(row.downtime_hours * 10) / 10
      totalDowntimeHours += dtHours

      // Assume 180 academic lab hours/month (30 days * 6 hours)
      const uptime = Math.max(70, Math.min(100, Math.round((1 - dtHours / 180) * 100)))

      return {
        workstation_id: row.id,
        workstation_label: row.label,
        row_label: row.row_label,
        device_type: row.device_type,
        status,
        total_issues_count: row.total_issues,
        open_issues_count: row.open_issues,
        resolved_issues_count: row.resolved_issues,
        critical_issues_count: row.critical_issues,
        downtime_hours: dtHours,
        uptime_pct: uptime,
        last_serviced_at: null,
      }
    })

    const totalWs = workstationRecords.length
    const overallUptime =
      totalWs > 0
        ? Math.round(
            workstationRecords.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.uptime_pct, 0) / totalWs
          )
        : 98

    // Hotspots: PCs with >= 1 reported issue sorted descending
    const hotspots = workstationRecords.filter((w) => w.total_issues_count > 0).slice(0, 8)

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        lab_id: targetLab,
        lab_name: 'Computer Engineering Lab 01',
        total_workstations: totalWs,
        operational_count: operationalCount,
        faulty_count: faultyCount,
        under_repair_count: underRepairCount,
        overall_uptime_pct: overallUptime,
        overall_mttr_hours: overallMttr,
        fault_categories_breakdown: categoryTally,
        hotspot_workstations: hotspots,
        workstations: workstationRecords,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching workstation reliability analytics:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch workstation analytics.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 6. Workstation Technical Lifecycle Biography
 * Answers: What is the full historical service and seating record for this specific PC?
 */
export async function getWorkstationTechnicalBiography(
  workstationId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: WorkstationBiography; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    // 1. Workstation Core
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, label, row_label, device_type, is_active, created_at 
       FROM public.workstations WHERE id = $1`,
      [workstationId]
    )
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Workstation not found.' }
    }
    const ws = wsRes.rows[0]

    // 2. Issues Timeline
    const issuesRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         id, title, severity, status, reported_by_name, created_at, resolved_at, resolution_notes,
         CASE 
           WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL 
           THEN ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1)::float
           ELSE NULL 
         END as duration_hours
       FROM public.workstation_issues
       WHERE workstation_id = $1
       ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
      [workstationId]
    )

    // Derive status
    const hasOpen = issuesRes.rows.some((i) => i.status !== 'resolved')
    const hasInProgress = issuesRes.rows.some((i) => i.status === 'in_progress')
    const derivedStatus = hasOpen ? (hasInProgress ? 'under_repair' : 'flagged') : 'operational'

    // 3. Maintenance Servicing History
    const maintRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         ml.id as log_id,
         mp.title as plan_title,
         COALESCE(p.full_name, ml.performed_by_id::text) as performed_by,
         ml.service_date as performed_at,
         COALESCE(ml.work_performed, ml.remarks) as observations
       FROM public.maintenance_logs ml
       LEFT JOIN public.maintenance_plans mp ON mp.id = ml.plan_id
       LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ml.performed_by_id
       WHERE ml.asset_identifier = $1 
          OR ml.remarks ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
       ORDER BY ml.service_date DESC`,
      [ws.label]
    )

    // 4. Student Seating History
    const seatingRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         ay.name as academic_year,
         c.name as class_name,
         s.full_name as student_name,
         se.roll_number
       FROM public.workstation_seat_plans wsp
       JOIN public.student_enrollments se ON se.id = wsp.enrollment_id
       JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
       JOIN public.classes c ON c.id = wsp.class_id
       JOIN public.academic_years ay ON ay.id = wsp.academic_year_id
       WHERE wsp.workstation_id = $1
       ORDER BY wsp.created_at DESC`,
      [workstationId]
    )

    // 5. Practical Session Forensic Usage Timeline
    const forensicRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         pl.id as log_id,
         pl.date,
         pl.period_label,
         pl.subject_name,
         pl.batch_group,
         pl.practical_title,
         pl.topic_learned,
         pl.seating_snapshot
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       WHERE pl.seating_snapshot IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC, pl.created_at DESC
       LIMIT 100`
    )

    const practicalUsageTimeline: NonNullable<WorkstationBiography['practical_usage_timeline']> = []

    for (const row of forensicRes.rows) {
      if (!Array.isArray(row.seating_snapshot)) continue
      const stationEntry = row.seating_snapshot.find(
        (entry: any) =>
          entry.workstation_id === workstationId ||
          (entry.workstation_label && entry.workstation_label.toLowerCase() === (ws.label || '').toLowerCase())
      )

      if (stationEntry && stationEntry.student_name) {
        practicalUsageTimeline.push({
          log_id: row.log_id,
          date: row.date,
          period_label: row.period_label || '',
          subject_name: row.subject_name || '',
          batch_group: row.batch_group || '',
          practical_title: row.practical_title || '',
          topic_learned: row.topic_learned || null,
          student_name: stationEntry.student_name,
          roll_number: stationEntry.roll_number != null ? Number(stationEntry.roll_number) : null,
          is_present: !!stationEntry.is_present,
          is_override: !!stationEntry.is_override,
          original_workstation_label: stationEntry.original_workstation_label || null,
        })
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        workstation_id: ws.id,
        label: ws.label,
        row_label: ws.row_label,
        device_type: ws.device_type,
        status: derivedStatus,
        created_at: ws.created_at,
        issues: issuesRes.rows,
        maintenance_history: maintRes.rows,
        student_seating_history: seatingRes.rows,
        practical_usage_timeline: practicalUsageTimeline,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching workstation biography:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch workstation biography.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 7. Real-time Derived Institutional Reminders & Operational Queue
 * Synthesizes alerts from canonical database relations:
 * - Critical workstation issues (> 48h or critical severity)
 * - Overdue preventive maintenance tasks
 * - Conducted practical logs pending Lab In-Charge dual sign-off
 * - Cohorts at risk of failing the NEB 75% attendance threshold
 */
export async function getInstitutionalReminders(): Promise<{
  success: boolean
  data?: InstitutionalReminderItem[]
  error?: string
}> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const reminders: InstitutionalReminderItem[] = []

    // 1. Critical open workstation issues
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT wi.id, wi.title, wi.severity, wi.created_at, w.label as ws_label, l.name as lab_name
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       LEFT JOIN public.labs l ON l.id = w.lab_id
       WHERE wi.status != 'resolved' AND wi.severity IN ('critical', 'high')
       ORDER BY wi.created_at DESC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    wsRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `ws-issue-${r.id}`,
        type: 'critical_workstation',
        severity: r.severity === 'critical' ? 'critical' : 'high',
        title: `Workstation Fault: ${r.ws_label}`,
        message: `${r.title} in ${r.lab_name || 'Laboratory'}. Immediate technician triage required.`,
        linkUrl: '/maintenance',
        timestamp: new Date(r.created_at).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 2. Overdue preventive maintenance tasks
    const mrRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT mr.id, mr.due_date, mp.title, l.name as lab_name
       FROM public.maintenance_reminders mr
       JOIN public.maintenance_plans mp ON mp.id = mr.plan_id
       LEFT JOIN public.labs l ON l.id = mp.lab_id
       WHERE mr.status IN ('pending', 'overdue') AND mr.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
       ORDER BY mr.due_date ASC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    mrRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `mr-overdue-${r.id}`,
        type: 'overdue_maintenance',
        severity: 'high',
        title: `Overdue Routine: ${r.title}`,
        message: `Maintenance for ${r.lab_name || 'Lab'} was due on ${r.due_date}.`,
        linkUrl: '/maintenance',
        timestamp: new Date(r.due_date).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 3. Conducted sessions pending verification audit (last 14 days)
    const verRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT pl.id, pl.practical_title, pl.date, pl.batch_group, pl.subject_name
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       WHERE pl.status = 'conducted'
         AND (pl.remarks IS NULL OR pl.remarks NOT ILIKE '%verified%')
         AND pl.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    verRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `pl-pending-${r.id}`,
        type: 'pending_verification',
        severity: 'medium',
        title: `Pending In-Charge Audit: ${r.batch_group}`,
        message: `"${r.practical_title}" conducted on ${r.date} requires digital dual sign-off.`,
        linkUrl: '/records',
        timestamp: new Date(r.date).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 4. Low attendance cohorts
    const compRes = await getStudentBoardComplianceReport({ classId: '12eng' })
    if (compRes.success && compRes.data && compRes.data.barred_students > 0) {
      reminders.push({
        id: `cohort-low-${compRes.data.class_id}`,
        type: 'low_attendance_cohort',
        severity: 'high',
        title: `Board Exam Alert: ${compRes.data.class_name}`,
        message: `${compRes.data.barred_students} student(s) currently below the 75% practical attendance threshold.`,
        linkUrl: '/analytics',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
    }

    return { success: true, data: reminders }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching institutional reminders:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch reminders.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 8. Export Student Board Compliance Register as Official Excel (.xlsx) or CSV
 */
export async function exportStudentBoardComplianceAction(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
  classId?: string
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean
  base64?: string
  filename?: string
  contentType?: string
  error?: string
}> {
  try {
    const reportRes = await getStudentBoardComplianceReport(params)
    if (!reportRes.success || !reportRes.data) {
      return { success: false, error: reportRes.error || 'Failed to retrieve compliance data.' }
    }

    const { generateStudentBoardComplianceXlsxBuffer } = await import('@/lib/exports/xlsx')
    const buffer = await generateStudentBoardComplianceXlsxBuffer(reportRes.data)
    const base64 = buffer.toString('base64')
    const cleanClassName = reportRes.data.class_name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    const filename = `NEB_Compliance_Register_${cleanClassName}_${reportRes.data.academic_year_name}.xlsx`

    return {
      success: true,
      base64,
      filename,
      contentType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to export compliance register.' }
  }
}

'use server'
 
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'
import { getServerUserScope } from '@/lib/context/server-user-scope'
import { recordAuditEvent } from '@/lib/audit'

import {
  type LabFacilityStatus,
  type LabFacilityPayload,
  validateLabStatus,
  deriveLabIsActive,
} from '@/lib/lab-status'

export type { LabFacilityPayload, LabFacilityStatus }

/**
 * Update an existing laboratory facility record in PostgreSQL.
 * Persists capacity, room code, status, and classification.
 */
export async function updateLabFacility(
  id: string,
  updates: Partial<LabFacilityPayload>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: any; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged || !['super_admin', 'lab_incharge'].includes(scope.role)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admin and Lab In-Charge can modify laboratory facilities.',
      }
    }

    let validatedStatus: LabFacilityStatus | null = null
    let isActive: boolean | null = null

    if (updates.status !== undefined) {
      validatedStatus = validateLabStatus(updates.status)
      isActive = deriveLabIsActive(validatedStatus)
    }

    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Fetch existing state for tamper-evident structured diff (match on id, code, or name)
    const prevRes = await pool.query(
      'SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1 OR (code IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(code) = UPPER($1)) OR (name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(name) = UPPER($1))',
      [id]
    )
    const beforeState = prevRes.rows[0] || null
    const targetLabId = beforeState?.id || id

    const res = await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.labs
      SET
        name = COALESCE($1, name),
        code = COALESCE($2, code),
        capacity = COALESCE($3, capacity),
        type = COALESCE($4, type),
        status = COALESCE($5, status),
        is_active = COALESCE($6, is_active)
      WHERE id = $7
      RETURNING *;
      `,
      [
        updates.name || null,
        updates.code ? updates.code.toUpperCase() : null,
        updates.capacity !== undefined ? Number(updates.capacity) : null,
        updates.type || null,
        validatedStatus,
        isActive,
        targetLabId,
      ]
    )

    if (res.rowCount === 0) {
      // If row does not exist, insert it
      const insertStatus = validatedStatus || 'Operational'
      const insertIsActive = isActive !== null ? isActive : true

      const insertRes = await pool.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO public.labs (id, name, code, capacity, type, status, is_active)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
          name = EXCLUDED.name,
          code = EXCLUDED.code,
          capacity = EXCLUDED.capacity,
          type = EXCLUDED.type,
          status = EXCLUDED.status,
          is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active
        RETURNING *;
        `,
        [
          targetLabId,
          updates.name || 'Laboratory Facility',
          updates.code ? updates.code.toUpperCase() : targetLabId.toUpperCase(),
          updates.capacity !== undefined ? Number(updates.capacity) : 40,
          updates.type || 'computer_lab',
          insertStatus,
          insertIsActive,
        ]
      )

      await recordAuditEvent({
        action: 'CREATE',
        entityType: 'lab',
        entityId: targetLabId,
        entityLabel: insertRes.rows[0]?.name || targetLabId,
        after: insertRes.rows[0],
        metadata: { operation: 'upsert_lab_facility' },
      })

      revalidatePath('/admin')
      revalidatePath('/maintenance')
      revalidatePath('/schedules')
      revalidatePath('/')
      return { success: true, data: insertRes.rows[0] }
    }

    // Record UPDATE audit event with structured diff
    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      entityType: 'lab',
      entityId: targetLabId,
      entityLabel: res.rows[0]?.name || beforeState?.name || updates.name || targetLabId,
      before: beforeState || { id: targetLabId },
      after: res.rows[0],
      metadata: { operation: 'update_lab_facility' },
    })

    // Revalidate affected cache paths
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/maintenance')
    revalidatePath('/schedules')
    revalidatePath('/')

    return { success: true, data: res.rows[0] }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`[LMR] Failed to update lab "${id}":`, err)
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Database update failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * Register a brand new laboratory room in PostgreSQL.
 */
export async function createLabFacility(
  lab: LabFacilityPayload
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: any; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged || !['super_admin', 'lab_incharge'].includes(scope.role)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admin and Lab In-Charge can register new laboratory facilities.',
      }
    }

    const validatedStatus = validateLabStatus(lab.status || 'Operational')
    const isActive = deriveLabIsActive(validatedStatus)

    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO public.labs (id, name, code, capacity, type, status, is_active)
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
        name = EXCLUDED.name,
        code = EXCLUDED.code,
        capacity = EXCLUDED.capacity,
        type = EXCLUDED.type,
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active
      RETURNING *;
      `,
      [
        lab.id,
        lab.name.trim(),
        lab.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
        Number(lab.capacity) || 40,
        lab.type || 'computer_lab',
        validatedStatus,
        isActive,
      ]
    )

    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'CREATE',
      entityType: 'lab',
      entityId: lab.id,
      entityLabel: lab.name.trim(),
      after: res.rows[0],
      metadata: { operation: 'create_lab_facility' },
    })

    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/maintenance')
    revalidatePath('/schedules')
    revalidatePath('/')

    return { success: true, data: res.rows[0] }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[LMR] Failed to create lab facility:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to create laboratory' }
  }
}

/**
 * Delete or deactivate a laboratory facility.
 */
export async function deleteLabFacility(
  id: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged || !['super_admin', 'lab_incharge'].includes(scope.role)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admin and Lab In-Charge can delete laboratory facilities.',
      }
    }

    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Query before-state for audit record
    const prevRes = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1', [id])
    const beforeState = prevRes.rows[0] || null

    // Attempt permanent deletion from PostgreSQL
    try {
      const delRes = await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;`, [id])
      if (delRes.rowCount && delRes.rowCount > 0) {
        await recordAuditEvent({
          action: 'DELETE',
          entityType: 'lab',
          entityId: id,
          entityLabel: beforeState?.name || id,
          before: beforeState,
          metadata: { operation: 'permanent_delete_lab' },
        })

        revalidatePath('/admin')
        revalidatePath('/maintenance')
        revalidatePath('/schedules')
        revalidatePath('/')
        return { success: true }
      }
    } catch (fkErr: any) {
      // Foreign key violation (PostgreSQL 23503) means active/historical records link to this room
      if (fkErr.code === '23503') {
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE public.labs SET is_active = false, status = 'Inactive' WHERE id = $1;`,
          [id]
        )

        await recordAuditEvent({
          action: 'UPDATE',
          entityType: 'lab',
          entityId: id,
          entityLabel: beforeState?.name || id,
          before: beforeState,
          after: { ...beforeState, is_active: false, status: 'Inactive' },
          metadata: {
            operation: 'soft_deactivate_lab',
            reason: 'linked_historical_records_fk_23503',
          },
        })

        revalidatePath('/admin')
        revalidatePath('/maintenance')
        revalidatePath('/schedules')
        revalidatePath('/')
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'This laboratory has linked historical records (practical logs, timetables, or maintenance) and cannot be permanently purged. It has been deactivated instead.',
        }
      }
      throw fkErr
    }

    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`[LMR] Failed to delete lab "${id}":`, err)
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to delete laboratory' }
  }
}

/**
 * Returns all laboratory facilities directly from public.labs table in PostgreSQL.
 */
export async function getLabFacilitiesAction(): Promise<{
  success: boolean
  data: LabFacilityPayload[]
  error?: string
}> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, name, code, capacity, type, status, is_active FROM public.labs ORDER BY name ASC;`
    )
    return {
      success: true,
      data: res.rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        name: r.name,
        code: r.code || r.id.toUpperCase(),
        capacity: Number(r.capacity || 40),
        type: r.type || 'computer_lab',
        status: r.status || 'Operational',
        is_active: Boolean(r.is_active),
      })),
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Failed to get lab facilities from PostgreSQL:', err)
    return { success: false, data: [], error: err?.message || 'Failed to get laboratories' }
  }
}

'use server'

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getServerUserScope } from '@/lib/context/server-user-scope'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { checkSchedulingConflicts } from '@/lib/scheduling/conflict-engine'
import { recordAuditEvent, recordSeatSwapAudit } from '@/lib/audit/audit-ledger'
import { checkServerDateSuspension } from '@/lib/calendar-policy'
import type { SeatingSnapshotEntry } from '@/lib/types/seat-plans'

export type { SeatingSnapshotEntry }

export interface LiveSessionContext {
  scheduleId: string
  classSubjectId: string
  classId: string
  className: string
  grade: number
  section?: string
  subjectId: string
  subjectCode: string
  subjectName: string
  labId: string
  labName: string
  academicYearId: string
  academicYearName: string
  sessionTeacherId: string
  curriculumTeacherId: string
  sessionTeacherName: string
  startTime: string
  endTime: string
  dayKey: string
  date: string
  isAdHoc: boolean
  isPrivileged: boolean
  isTeacher: boolean
  canEdit: boolean
  expectedRoster: Array<{
    enrollmentId: string
    studentId: string
    rollNumber: number
    fullName: string
    admissionNo: string
    gender?: string
    photoUrl?: string | null
    status: string
  }>
  seatPlan: Record<string, {
    enrollmentId: string
    studentId: string
    rollNumber: number
    fullName: string
    photoUrl?: string | null
    isOverride: boolean
    originalWorkstationLabel?: string | null
    originalWorkstationId?: string | null
  }>
  existingLog?: {
    id: string
    practicalTitle: string
    presentStudents: number
    absentStudents: number
    absentRolls: number[]
    createdAt: string
    isLocked: boolean
    hoursRemainingInEditWindow: number
    status?: string | null
    skipReason?: string | null
    seatingSnapshot?: SeatingSnapshotEntry[] | null
  } | null
  existingAttendance?: Record<number, boolean>
}

/**
 * 5.1 Live Session Context Resolver
 * Derives complete relational bundle from scheduleId with zero string guessing.
 */
export async function getLiveSessionContext(
  scheduleId: string,
  sessionDate?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: LiveSessionContext; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()

    // 1. Fetch schedule and join relational chain
    const { data: sched, error: schedErr } = await (supabase
      .from('schedules') as any)
      .select(`
        id, lab_id, teacher_id, start_time, end_time, day_key, class_subject_id, academic_year_id,
        class_subjects:class_subject_id (
          id, class_id, subject_id, teacher_id, academic_year_id,
          classes:class_id ( id, name, grade, section ),
          subjects:subject_id ( id, code, name ),
          academic_years:academic_year_id ( id, name, is_current ),
          profiles:teacher_id ( id, full_name )
        ),
        labs:lab_id ( id, name )
      `)
      .eq('id', scheduleId)
      .maybeSingle()

    if (schedErr || !sched) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Schedule slot not found or inaccessible.' }
    }

    const cs = sched.class_subjects
    if (!cs) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Curriculum assignment (class_subject) missing for this schedule.' }
    }

    const cls = cs.classes
    const sub = cs.subjects
    const ay = cs.academic_years
    const lab = sched.labs

    const classId = cs.class_id
    const academicYearId = cs.academic_year_id || sched.academic_year_id || '2083'

    // Verify teacher scope: If user is teacher, must teach this class/subject or be session teacher
    if (scope.isTeacher && !scope.isPrivileged) {
      const isAssignedCurriculum = cs.teacher_id === scope.userId
      const isAssignedSession = sched.teacher_id === scope.userId
      const hasClassAccess = scope.assignedClasses.includes(cls?.name || classId)
      if (!isAssignedCurriculum && !isAssignedSession && !hasClassAccess) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Access denied: You are not assigned to conduct or manage this session.' }
      }
    }

    // Resolve session teacher profile name
    let sessionTeacherName = 'Assigned Faculty'
    if (sched.teacher_id) {
      const { data: prof } = await (supabase
        .from('profiles') as any)
        .select('full_name')
        .eq('id', sched.teacher_id)
        .maybeSingle()
      if (prof?.full_name) {
        sessionTeacherName = prof.full_name
      }
    } else if (cs.profiles?.full_name) {
      sessionTeacherName = cs.profiles.full_name
    }

    // 2. Fetch Expected Roster from student_enrollments
    const { data: enrollmentsData, error: enrErr } = await (supabase
      .from('student_enrollments') as any)
      .select(`
        id, student_id, roll_number, status,
        students:student_id ( id, full_name, admission_no, gender, photo_url )
      `)
      .eq('class_id', classId)
      .eq('academic_year_id', academicYearId)
      .eq('status', 'active')
      .order('roll_number', { ascending: true })

    if (enrErr) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Failed to retrieve cohort roster.' }
    }

    const expectedRoster = (enrollmentsData || []).map((e: any) => ({
      enrollmentId: e.id,
      studentId: e.student_id,
      rollNumber: e.roll_number,
      fullName: e.students?.full_name || `Roll ${e.roll_number}`,
      admissionNo: e.students?.admission_no || '',
      gender: e.students?.gender,
      photoUrl: e.students?.photo_url || null,
      status: e.status,
    }))

    // Build enrollment map for lookup
    const enrollmentMap = new Map<string, typeof expectedRoster[0]>()
    expectedRoster.forEach((s: typeof expectedRoster[0]) => enrollmentMap.set(s.enrollmentId, s))

    // Fetch lab workstation labels for human-readable relocation tracking
    const { data: labWorkstations } = await (supabase
      .from('workstations') as any)
      .select('id, label')
      .eq('lab_id', sched.lab_id)

    const wsLabelMap = new Map<string, string>(
      (labWorkstations || []).map((w: any) => [w.id, w.label])
    )

    // 3. Fetch Tier 1 Baseline Seat Plan
    const { data: tier1Data } = await (supabase
      .from('workstation_seat_plans') as any)
      .select('workstation_id, enrollment_id')
      .eq('class_id', classId)
      .eq('academic_year_id', academicYearId)

    const effectiveSeatPlan: LiveSessionContext['seatPlan'] = {}
    const studentBaselineWsMap = new Map<string, string>()

    if (tier1Data) {
      for (const row of tier1Data as any[]) {
        const student = enrollmentMap.get(row.enrollment_id)
        if (student) {
          studentBaselineWsMap.set(student.enrollmentId, row.workstation_id)
          effectiveSeatPlan[row.workstation_id] = {
            enrollmentId: student.enrollmentId,
            studentId: student.studentId,
            rollNumber: student.rollNumber,
            fullName: student.fullName,
            photoUrl: student.photoUrl,
            isOverride: false,
            originalWorkstationLabel: wsLabelMap.get(row.workstation_id) || null,
            originalWorkstationId: row.workstation_id,
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Fetch Tier 2 Session Overrides (if session date is specified)
    const activeDate = sessionDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]

    // Authoritative Server-Side Holiday & Recess Guard
    const suspension = await checkServerDateSuspension(activeDate)
    if (suspension.isSuspended) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Session locked: ${activeDate} is designated as an institutional ${suspension.type === 'holiday' ? 'holiday' : 'recess'} (${suspension.title}). Laboratory practical operations and attendance tracking are suspended.`,
      }
    }
    const { data: tier2Data } = await (supabase
      .from('session_seat_overrides') as any)
      .select('workstation_id, enrollment_id')
      .eq('schedule_id', scheduleId)
      .eq('session_date', activeDate)

    if (tier2Data) {
      for (const override of tier2Data as any[]) {
        const student = enrollmentMap.get(override.enrollment_id)
        if (student) {
          const originalWsId = studentBaselineWsMap.get(student.enrollmentId)
          const originalWsLabel = originalWsId ? wsLabelMap.get(originalWsId) : null

          // CRITICAL INVARIANT: Vacate ANY prior workstation where this student was assigned
          // so the student does not simultaneously appear at both broken PC and temp PC.
          for (const [existingWsId, existingEntry] of Object.entries(effectiveSeatPlan)) {
            if (existingEntry.enrollmentId === student.enrollmentId && existingWsId !== override.workstation_id) {
              delete effectiveSeatPlan[existingWsId]
            }
          }

          effectiveSeatPlan[override.workstation_id] = {
            enrollmentId: student.enrollmentId,
            studentId: student.studentId,
            rollNumber: student.rollNumber,
            fullName: student.fullName,
            photoUrl: student.photoUrl,
            isOverride: true,
            originalWorkstationLabel: originalWsLabel || null,
            originalWorkstationId: originalWsId || null,
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 5. Check if practical log already exists for this schedule and date
    const { data: existingLogData } = await (supabase
      .from('practical_logs') as any)
      .select('id, practical_title, present_students, absent_students, absent_rolls, created_at, seating_snapshot, status, skip_reason')
      .eq('schedule_id', scheduleId)
      .eq('date', activeDate)
      .maybeSingle()

    let existingLog: LiveSessionContext['existingLog'] = null
    let existingAttendance: Record<number, boolean> | undefined = undefined

    if (existingLogData) {
      const createdAt = new Date(existingLogData.created_at).getTime()
      const now = Date.now()
      const ageHours = (now - createdAt) / (1000 * 60 * 60)
      const isLocked = !scope.isPrivileged && ageHours > 24
      const hoursRemaining = Math.max(0, 24 - ageHours)

      existingLog = {
        id: existingLogData.id,
        practicalTitle: existingLogData.practical_title,
        presentStudents: existingLogData.present_students,
        absentStudents: existingLogData.absent_students,
        absentRolls: existingLogData.absent_rolls || [],
        createdAt: existingLogData.created_at,
        isLocked,
        hoursRemainingInEditWindow: Math.round(hoursRemaining * 10) / 10,
        status: existingLogData.status || null,
        skipReason: existingLogData.skip_reason || null,
        seatingSnapshot: existingLogData.seating_snapshot || null,
      }

      // Fetch attendance rows
      const { data: attRows } = await (supabase
        .from('log_attendance') as any)
        .select('roll_number, is_present')
        .eq('log_id', existingLogData.id)

      if (attRows) {
        existingAttendance = {}
        for (const row of attRows as any[]) {
          existingAttendance[row.roll_number] = row.is_present
        }
      }
    }

    const canEdit = scope.isPrivileged || !existingLog || !existingLog.isLocked

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        scheduleId: sched.id,
        classSubjectId: cs.id,
        classId,
        className: cls?.name || classId,
        grade: cls?.grade || 12,
        section: cls?.section,
        subjectId: sub?.id || '',
        subjectCode: sub?.code || '',
        subjectName: sub?.name || '',
        labId: sched.lab_id,
        labName: lab?.name || 'Computer Laboratory',
        academicYearId,
        academicYearName: ay?.name || '2083 B.S. (2026/27 A.D.)',
        sessionTeacherId: sched.teacher_id,
        curriculumTeacherId: cs.teacher_id,
        sessionTeacherName,
        startTime: sched.start_time,
        endTime: sched.end_time,
        dayKey: sched.day_key,
        date: activeDate,
        isAdHoc: sched.id.startsWith('adhoc-'),
        isPrivileged: scope.isPrivileged,
        isTeacher: scope.isTeacher,
        canEdit,
        expectedRoster,
        seatPlan: effectiveSeatPlan,
        existingLog,
        existingAttendance,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error resolving live session context:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Internal error resolving live session context.' }
  }
}

/**
 * Ad-Hoc / Makeup Session Fallback
 * Generates an ad-hoc schedule entry linked to canonical class_subjects
 * so the relational pipeline flows without error.
 */
export async function createAdHocSession(params: {
  classSubjectId: string
  labId: string
  startTime: string
  endTime: string
  date: string
  teacherId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; scheduleId?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (scope.isPending || scope.approvalStatus !== 'approved') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Your faculty account is pending verification and not approved.' }
    }

    if (!scope.isPrivileged && !scope.isTeacher) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Only faculty members and administrators can start sessions.' }
    }

    // Authoritative Server-Side Holiday & Recess Guard
    const suspension = await checkServerDateSuspension(params.date)
    if (suspension.isSuspended) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Ad-hoc session creation rejected: ${params.date} is an official institutional ${suspension.type === 'holiday' ? 'holiday' : 'recess'} (${suspension.title}). Laboratory practicals are suspended.`,
      }
    }

    // 1. Verify class_subject exists
    const { data: cs, error: csErr } = await (supabase
      .from('class_subjects') as any)
      .select(`
        id, class_id, subject_id, teacher_id, academic_year_id,
        classes:class_id ( name ),
        subjects:subject_id ( name )
      `)
      .eq('id', params.classSubjectId)
      .maybeSingle()

    if (csErr || !cs) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Invalid curriculum assignment (class_subject_id).' }
    }

    // Check teacher scope
    if (scope.isTeacher && !scope.isPrivileged) {
      const isAssigned = cs.teacher_id === scope.userId
      const hasClassAccess = scope.assignedClasses.includes(cs.classes?.name || cs.class_id)
      if (!isAssigned && !hasClassAccess) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Access denied: You are not authorized for this class/subject assignment.' }
      }
    }

    const sessionTeacherId = params.teacherId || scope.userId || cs.teacher_id
    const adHocScheduleId = `adhoc-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`

    // Map date to day_key (sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat)
    const dayIndex = new Date(params.date).getDay()
    const dayKeys = ['sun', 'mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat']
    const dayKey = dayKeys[dayIndex] || 'sun'

    // 2. Triple-Collision Conflict Defense Check
    const conflictCheck = await checkSchedulingConflicts({
      labId: params.labId,
      teacherId: sessionTeacherId,
      classSubjectId: cs.id,
      classId: cs.class_id,
      batchName: cs.classes?.name,
      dayKey,
      startTime: params.startTime,
      endTime: params.endTime,
    })

    if (conflictCheck.hasConflict) {
      return { success: false, error: conflictCheck.message || 'Scheduling conflict detected.' }
    }

    // Create ad-hoc schedule record
    const { error: insErr } = await (supabase
      .from('schedules') as any)
      .insert({
        id: adHocScheduleId,
        lab_id: params.labId,
        teacher_id: sessionTeacherId,
        subject_name: cs.subjects?.name || 'Practical Session',
        batch_name: cs.classes?.name || 'Class Cohort',
        start_time: params.startTime,
        end_time: params.endTime,
        slot_id: 'adhoc',
        day_key: dayKey,
        class_subject_id: cs.id,
        academic_year_id: cs.academic_year_id,
      })

    if (insErr) {
      console.error('Failed to create ad-hoc schedule:', insErr)
      return { success: false, error: 'Failed to initiate ad-hoc session schedule.' }
    }

    // 3. Record Audit Log for Ad-Hoc Session Creation
    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'CREATE',
      entityType: 'schedule',
      entityId: adHocScheduleId,
      entityLabel: `Ad-Hoc Session: ${cs.subjects?.name || 'Practical'} (${cs.classes?.name || 'Cohort'}) @ ${params.labId.toUpperCase()}`,
      after: {
        lab_id: params.labId,
        teacher_id: sessionTeacherId,
        start_time: params.startTime,
        end_time: params.endTime,
        is_adhoc: true,
      },
      metadata: {
        is_adhoc: true,
        date: params.date,
      },
    })

    revalidatePath('/computer-lab')
    revalidatePath('/schedules')
    return { success: true, scheduleId: adHocScheduleId }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error creating ad-hoc session:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to start ad-hoc session.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 5.4 Submit Live Session Practical Log & In-Seat Attendance
 * Atomically writes practical_logs and batch inserts public.log_attendance
 * with composite foreign key protection.
 */
export async function submitLiveSession(params: {
  scheduleId: string
  practicalTitle: string
  date: string
  attendance: Array<{
    studentId: string
    enrollmentId: string
    rollNumber: number
    isPresent: boolean
  }>
  remarks?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; logId?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (scope.isPending || scope.approvalStatus !== 'approved') {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Action Rejected: Your faculty account is pending verification and not approved. Practical sessions cannot be submitted.',
      }
    }

    // 0. Authoritative Server-Side Holiday & Recess Guard
    const suspension = await checkServerDateSuspension(params.date)
    if (suspension.isSuspended) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Practical log submission rejected: ${params.date} is an official institutional ${suspension.type === 'holiday' ? 'holiday' : 'recess'} (${suspension.title}). Laboratory practicals and attendance tallies are suspended on holidays and scheduled recesses.`,
      }
    }

    // 1. Resolve context to verify permissions and get canonical IDs
    const contextRes = await getLiveSessionContext(params.scheduleId, params.date)
    if (!contextRes.success || !contextRes.data) {
      return { success: false, error: contextRes.error || 'Failed to resolve session context.' }
    }
    const ctx = contextRes.data

    if (!ctx.canEdit) {
      return { success: false, error: 'This session log is finalized and locked. The 24-hour edit window has expired.' }
    }

    const safeTitle = (params.practicalTitle || '').trim() || 'Laboratory Practical Session'
    const totalStudents = params.attendance.length
    const presentStudents = params.attendance.filter((a) => a.isPresent).length
    const absentStudents = totalStudents - presentStudents
    const absentRolls = params.attendance
      .filter((a) => !a.isPresent)
      .map((a) => a.rollNumber)
      .sort((a, b) => a - b)

    // Build frozen session seating snapshot
    const { data: workstations } = await (supabase
      .from('workstations') as any)
      .select('id, label, row_label')
      .eq('lab_id', ctx.labId)
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .order('label', { ascending: true })

    const attendanceMap = new Map<string, boolean>()
    for (const att of params.attendance) {
      if (att.enrollmentId) attendanceMap.set(att.enrollmentId, att.isPresent)
      if (att.studentId) attendanceMap.set(att.studentId, att.isPresent)
      attendanceMap.set(String(att.rollNumber), att.isPresent)
    }

    const seatingSnapshot: SeatingSnapshotEntry[] = (workstations || []).map((ws: any) => {
      const seat = ctx.seatPlan[ws.id]
      if (!seat) {
        return {
          workstation_id: ws.id,
          workstation_label: ws.label,
          row_label: ws.row_label || null,
          student_id: null,
          enrollment_id: null,
          student_name: null,
          roll_number: null,
          is_present: false,
          is_override: false,
          original_workstation_label: null,
          notes: null,
        }
      }

      const isPresent =
        (seat.enrollmentId && attendanceMap.has(seat.enrollmentId) ? attendanceMap.get(seat.enrollmentId) : undefined) ??
        (seat.studentId && attendanceMap.has(seat.studentId) ? attendanceMap.get(seat.studentId) : undefined) ??
        attendanceMap.get(String(seat.rollNumber)) ??
        true

      return {
        workstation_id: ws.id,
        workstation_label: ws.label,
        row_label: ws.row_label || null,
        student_id: seat.studentId,
        enrollment_id: seat.enrollmentId,
        student_name: seat.fullName,
        roll_number: seat.rollNumber,
        is_present: !!isPresent,
        is_override: !!seat.isOverride,
        original_workstation_label: seat.originalWorkstationLabel || null,
        notes: seat.isOverride
          ? seat.originalWorkstationLabel
            ? `Relocated from ${seat.originalWorkstationLabel}`
            : 'Session relocation override'
          : null,
      }
    })

    let logId = ctx.existingLog?.id

    if (logId) {
      // 2A. Update Existing Practical Log (within 24-hr window)
      const { error: updateErr } = await (supabase
        .from('practical_logs') as any)
        .update({
          practical_title: safeTitle,
          total_students: totalStudents,
          present_students: presentStudents,
          absent_students: absentStudents,
          absent_rolls: absentRolls,
          remarks: params.remarks || null,
          topic_learned: safeTitle,
          seating_snapshot: seatingSnapshot,
        })
        .eq('id', logId)

      if (updateErr) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Failed to update practical log record.' }
      }
    } else {
      // 2B. Insert New Practical Log
      logId = `LOG-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`
      const { error: insErr } = await (supabase
        .from('practical_logs') as any)
        .insert({
          id: logId,
          schedule_id: ctx.scheduleId,
          lab_id: ctx.labId,
          teacher_id: ctx.sessionTeacherId,
          date: ctx.date,
          period_label: `${ctx.startTime} – ${ctx.endTime}`,
          subject_name: `${ctx.subjectCode} - ${ctx.subjectName}`,
          batch_group: ctx.className,
          practical_title: safeTitle,
          total_students: totalStudents,
          present_students: presentStudents,
          absent_students: absentStudents,
          absent_rolls: absentRolls,
          remarks: params.remarks || null,
          status: 'conducted',
          topic_learned: safeTitle,
          seating_snapshot: seatingSnapshot,
          class_subject_id: ctx.classSubjectId,
          academic_year_id: ctx.academicYearId,
          logged_by: scope.userId || ctx.sessionTeacherId,
        })

      if (insErr) {
        console.error('Failed to insert practical log:', insErr)
        return { success: false, error: 'Failed to create practical session log.' }
      }
    }

    // 3. Atomically upsert log_attendance records
    const attendanceRecords = params.attendance.map((att) => ({
      id: `${logId}-roll-${att.rollNumber}`,
      log_id: logId,
      enrollment_id: att.enrollmentId,
      student_id: att.studentId,
      roll_number: att.rollNumber,
      is_present: att.isPresent,
    }))

    const { error: attErr } = await (supabase
      .from('log_attendance') as any)
      .upsert(attendanceRecords, { onConflict: 'log_id,roll_number' })

    if (attErr) {
      console.error('Failed to record student attendance:', attErr)
      return { success: false, error: 'Practical log saved, but attendance records failed to sync.' }
    }

    // 4. Record Audit Event for Practical Log & Attendance Submission
    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: ctx.existingLog?.id ? 'UPDATE' : 'CREATE',
      entityType: 'attendance',
      entityId: logId,
      entityLabel: `${ctx.className} - ${ctx.subjectName} (${safeTitle})`,
      before: ctx.existingLog
        ? {
            present_students: ctx.existingLog.presentStudents,
            absent_students: ctx.existingLog.absentStudents,
          }
        : null,
      after: {
        present_students: presentStudents,
        absent_students: absentStudents,
      },
      metadata: {
        schedule_id: ctx.scheduleId,
        lab_id: ctx.labId,
        date: ctx.date,
        total_students: totalStudents,
        present_count: presentStudents,
        absent_count: absentStudents,
      },
    })

    revalidatePath('/computer-lab')
    revalidatePath('/records')
    revalidatePath('/')
    return { success: true, logId }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error submitting live session:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Internal error submitting live session.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 5.5 Temporary Session Seat Override
 * Temporarily moves a student from one PC to another for today's session only.
 * Leaves Tier 1 baseline untouched.
 */
export async function assignSessionSeatOverride(params: {
  scheduleId: string
  sessionDate: string
  workstationId: string
  enrollmentId: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()

    if (!scope.isPrivileged && !scope.isTeacher) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized to adjust session seating.' }
    }

    // Authoritative Server-Side Holiday & Recess Guard
    const suspension = await checkServerDateSuspension(params.sessionDate)
    if (suspension.isSuspended) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Seat reassignment rejected: ${params.sessionDate} is an official institutional ${suspension.type === 'holiday' ? 'holiday' : 'recess'} (${suspension.title}).`,
      }
    }

    const { error } = await (supabase
      .from('session_seat_overrides') as any)
      .upsert(
        {
          schedule_id: params.scheduleId,
          session_date: params.sessionDate,
          workstation_id: params.workstationId,
          enrollment_id: params.enrollmentId,
          created_by: scope.userId,
        },
        { onConflict: 'schedule_id,session_date,workstation_id' }
      )

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Failed to record session seat override.' }
    }

    // Remove any previous temporary relocation for this student on other workstations
    // for this exact session so the student occupies strictly one workstation.
    await (supabase
      .from('session_seat_overrides') as any)
      .delete()
      .eq('schedule_id', params.scheduleId)
      .eq('session_date', params.sessionDate)
      .eq('enrollment_id', params.enrollmentId)
      .neq('workstation_id', params.workstationId)

    // Record Audit Event for Session Seat Override
    await recordSeatSwapAudit({
      scheduleId: params.scheduleId,
      sessionDate: params.sessionDate,
      fromWorkstation: 'Baseline Seat',
      toWorkstation: params.workstationId,
      studentName: `Enrollment ${params.enrollmentId}`,
      rollNumber: 0,
    })

    revalidatePath('/computer-lab')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to record session override.' }
  }
}
