import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import {
  dispatchTeacherDailyReminders,
  dispatchOverdueMaintenanceAlerts,
  dispatchUpcomingHolidayNotices,
} from '@/app/actions/notifications'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  return handleCron(req)
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  return handleCron(req)
}

async function handleCron(req: NextRequest) {
  const startTime = Date.now()

  // 1. Strict CRON_SECRET authorization check
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization')
  if (process.env.CRON_SECRET && authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
  }

  // Check if force parameter is provided for manual testing
  const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams
  const force = searchParams.get('force') === 'true'

  try {
    // 2. Execute parallel scheduled scans
    const [teacherReminders, overdueMaintenance, holidayNotices] = await Promise.all([
      dispatchTeacherDailyReminders(force),
      dispatchOverdueMaintenanceAlerts(force),
      dispatchUpcomingHolidayNotices(force),
    ])

    const durationMs = Date.now() - startTime

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      durationMs,
      summary: {
        teacherReminders: {
          dispatched: teacherReminders.dispatchedCount,
          skippedDuplicates: teacherReminders.skippedDuplicates,
          message: (teacherReminders as any).message,
        },
        overdueMaintenance: {
          dispatched: overdueMaintenance.dispatchedCount,
          skippedDuplicates: overdueMaintenance.skippedCount,
          overdueLabCount: overdueMaintenance.overdueLabCount,
          message: (overdueMaintenance as any).message,
        },
        holidayNotices: {
          dispatched: holidayNotices.dispatchedCount,
          holidaysFound: holidayNotices.holidaysFound,
          message: (holidayNotices as any).message,
        },
      },
    })
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[Cron Error] Automated email dispatch failed:', err)
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Internal server error during cron dispatch',
      },
      { status: 500 }
    )
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { getServerUserScope } from '@/lib/context/server-user-scope'
import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'
import { getPracticalRecords, getIncidentRecords } from '@/app/actions/records'
import { getStudentBoardComplianceReport } from '@/app/actions/institutional-reports'
import { exportMaintenanceRecordsAction } from '@/app/actions/maintenance'
import {
  generatePracticalRecordsXlsxBuffer,
  generateIncidentRecordsXlsxBuffer,
  generateStudentBoardComplianceXlsxBuffer,
} from '@/lib/exports/xlsx'
import {
  generatePracticalRecordsCsv,
  generateIncidentRecordsCsv,
} from '@/lib/exports/csv'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

const XLSX_CONTENT_TYPE = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
const CSV_CONTENT_TYPE = 'text/csv; charset=utf-8'

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ type: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const { type } = await context.params
    const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams
    const format = (searchParams.get('format') || 'xlsx').toLowerCase() === 'csv' ? 'csv' : 'xlsx'

    // 1. Authenticate user session
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.userId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized: Active user session required.' }, { status: 401 })
    }

    // 2. Dispatch to dedicated export generator
    switch (type) {
      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      // Practical Logbook Records
      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      case 'practical-records': {
        const lab_id = searchParams.get('lab_id') || undefined
        const academic_year_id = searchParams.get('academic_year_id') || undefined
        const date_from = searchParams.get('date_from') || undefined
        const date_to = searchParams.get('date_to') || undefined
        const search = searchParams.get('search') || undefined
        const status = searchParams.get('status') || undefined
        const batch_group = searchParams.get('batch_group') || undefined
        const groupBy = (searchParams.get('groupBy') || 'none') as any
        const selectedIdsParam = searchParams.get('selected_ids')
        const colsParam = searchParams.get('cols')
        const visibleColumns = colsParam ? colsParam.split(',') : undefined

        const selectedIds = selectedIdsParam ? selectedIdsParam.split(',') : undefined
        const exportFilters: any = {
          lab_id: lab_id && lab_id !== 'all' ? lab_id : undefined,
          academic_year_id: academic_year_id && academic_year_id !== 'all' ? academic_year_id : undefined,
          date_from,
          date_to,
          search,
          status: status && status !== 'all' ? status : undefined,
          batch_group: batch_group && batch_group !== 'all' ? batch_group : undefined,
          selected_ids: selectedIds,
        }

        const data = await getPracticalRecords(exportFilters, groupBy)
        if (!data.success) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: data.error || 'Failed to fetch practical records.' }, { status: 400 })
        }

        let resolvedYearName: string | undefined = undefined
        if (academic_year_id && academic_year_id !== 'all') {
          try {
            const pool = getPgPool()
            const ayRes = await pool.query(`SELECT name FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = $1;`, [academic_year_id])
            if (ayRes.rows.length > 0) resolvedYearName = ayRes.rows[0].name
          } catch {}
        }

        const fromStr = date_from || 'start'
        const toStr = date_to || 'end'
        const yearPrefix = academic_year_id && academic_year_id !== 'all' ? `_ay-${academic_year_id}` : ''
        const selPrefix = selectedIds && selectedIds.length > 0 ? `_selected-${selectedIds.length}` : ''
        const filename = `practical-records${yearPrefix}_${groupBy}${selPrefix}_${fromStr}_${toStr}.${format}`

        if (format === 'csv') {
          const csvContent = generatePracticalRecordsCsv(data.sections, {
            labName: lab_id ? lab_id.toUpperCase() : 'All Laboratories',
            dateRange: `${date_from || 'Earliest'} to ${date_to || 'Latest'}`,
            academicYear: resolvedYearName || (academic_year_id !== 'all' ? academic_year_id : undefined),
            visibleColumns,
          })
          const buffer = Buffer.from(csvContent, 'utf-8')
          return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': CSV_CONTENT_TYPE,
              'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
              'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
              'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
            },
          })
        } else {
          const buffer = await generatePracticalRecordsXlsxBuffer(data.sections, {
            labName: lab_id ? lab_id.toUpperCase() : 'All Laboratories',
            dateRange: `${date_from || 'Earliest'} to ${date_to || 'Latest'}`,
            groupByLabel: groupBy.toUpperCase(),
            academicYear: resolvedYearName || (academic_year_id !== 'all' ? academic_year_id : undefined),
            visibleColumns,
          })
          return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': XLSX_CONTENT_TYPE,
              'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
              'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
              'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
            },
          })
        }
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      // NEB Board Exam 75% Attendance Compliance Register
      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      case 'neb-compliance': {
        const academic_year_id = searchParams.get('academic_year_id')
        const class_id = searchParams.get('class_id')

        if (!academic_year_id || !class_id) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'Missing required parameters: academic_year_id and class_id' },
            { status: 400 }
          )
        }

        const reportRes = await getStudentBoardComplianceReport({
          academicYearId: academic_year_id,
          classId: class_id,
        })
        if (!reportRes.success || !reportRes.data) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: reportRes.error || 'Failed to retrieve compliance data.' },
            { status: 400 }
          )
        }

        const buffer = await generateStudentBoardComplianceXlsxBuffer(reportRes.data)
        const cleanClassName = reportRes.data.class_name.replace(/\s+/g, '_')
        const filename = `NEB_Compliance_Register_${cleanClassName}_${reportRes.data.academic_year_name}.xlsx`

        return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': XLSX_CONTENT_TYPE,
            'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
            'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
            'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
          },
        })
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      // Equipment Breakage & Incident Register
      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      case 'incident-records': {
        const lab_id = searchParams.get('lab_id') || undefined
        const date_from = searchParams.get('date_from') || undefined
        const date_to = searchParams.get('date_to') || undefined
        const search = searchParams.get('search') || undefined
        const severity = searchParams.get('severity') || undefined
        const status = searchParams.get('status') || undefined
        const colsParam = searchParams.get('cols')
        const visibleColumns = colsParam ? colsParam.split(',') : undefined

        const data = await getIncidentRecords({
          lab_id: lab_id && lab_id !== 'all' ? lab_id : undefined,
          date_from,
          date_to,
          search,
          severity: severity && severity !== 'all' ? severity : undefined,
          status: status && status !== 'all' ? status : undefined,
        })

        if (!data.success) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: data.error || 'Failed to fetch incident records.' }, { status: 400 })
        }

        const fromStr = date_from || 'start'
        const toStr = date_to || 'end'
        const filename = `incident-records_${lab_id || 'all'}_${fromStr}_${toStr}.${format}`

        if (format === 'csv') {
          const csvContent = generateIncidentRecordsCsv(data.incidents, {
            labName: lab_id ? lab_id.toUpperCase() : 'All Laboratories',
            dateRange: `${date_from || 'Earliest'} to ${date_to || 'Latest'}`,
            visibleColumns,
          })
          const buffer = Buffer.from(csvContent, 'utf-8')
          return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': CSV_CONTENT_TYPE,
              'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
              'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
              'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
            },
          })
        } else {
          const buffer = await generateIncidentRecordsXlsxBuffer(data.incidents, data.metrics, {
            labName: lab_id ? lab_id.toUpperCase() : 'All Laboratories',
            dateRange: `${date_from || 'Earliest'} to ${date_to || 'Latest'}`,
            visibleColumns,
          })
          return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': XLSX_CONTENT_TYPE,
              'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
              'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
              'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
            },
          })
        }
      }

      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      // Laboratory Maintenance & Service History Logbook
      // -------------------------------------------------------------
      case 'maintenance-records': {
        const labId = searchParams.get('lab_id') || 'all'
        const result = await exportMaintenanceRecordsAction(labId, format)
        if (!result.success || !result.base64) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error || 'Failed to export maintenance records' }, { status: 400 })
        }

        const buffer = Buffer.from(result.base64, 'base64')
        return new Response(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': result.contentType || (format === 'csv' ? CSV_CONTENT_TYPE : XLSX_CONTENT_TYPE),
            'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${result.filename || `maintenance-records.${format}`}"`,
            'Content-Length': buffer.length.toString(),
            'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache',
          },
        })
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown export type "${type}".` }, { status: 404 })
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[export route error]:', err)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || 'Internal server error during export' }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'
import {
  createHandshakeTicket,
  safeEqual,
} from '@/lib/security/terminal-token'
import { recordAuditEvent } from '@/lib/audit/audit-ledger'

/**
 * Handshake endpoint for the physical Windows client agent (labsync-agent.ps1).
 * Authenticates machine identity via composite MachineGuid, enforces TOFU hardware lock,
 * saves live hardware telemetry, and issues a 60-second single-use login ticket.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // 1. Optional Institutional Key Verification
    const agentSecret = process.env.LABSYNC_AGENT_KEY
    if (agentSecret) {
      const clientKey = req.headers.get('x-labsync-agent-key')
      if (!clientKey || !safeEqual(clientKey, agentSecret)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Invalid institutional agent key.' },
          { status: 401 }
        )
      }
    }

    // 2. Parse Payload
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => null)
    if (!body) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'Malformed JSON payload.' },
        { status: 400 }
      )
    }

    const { computer_name, machine_guid, hardware_specs } = body

    const trimmedCode = (computer_name || '').trim()
    const trimmedGuid = (machine_guid || '').trim()

    if (!trimmedCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'Workstation computer_name / label required.' },
        { status: 400 }
      )
    }

    if (!trimmedGuid) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: 'Composite machine_guid required.' },
        { status: 400 }
      )
    }

    // Determine client IP
    const forwardedFor = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')
    const clientIp = forwardedFor ? forwardedFor.split(',')[0].trim() : req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || null

    const pool = getPgPool()

    // 3. Lookup Workstation by label (e.g. PC-14) or UUID
    const findQuery = `
      SELECT 
        id, 
        label, 
        machine_guid, 
        lan_ip,
        lab_id,
        is_active
      FROM public.workstations
      WHERE LOWER(label) = LOWER($1) OR id::text = $1
      LIMIT 1
    `
    const findRes = await pool.query(findQuery, [trimmedCode])

    if (findRes.rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: `Workstation "${trimmedCode}" not found in laboratory floor plan inventory.`,
        },
        { status: 404 }
      )
    }

    const ws = findRes.rows[0]
    const workstationId = ws.id
    const stationLabel = ws.label
    const existingGuid = ws.machine_guid

    // 4. TOFU (Trust-On-First-Use) Hardware Lock Enforcement
    const isFirstTimePairing = !existingGuid

    if (!isFirstTimePairing) {
      // Station already has a registered hardware GUID: verify match
      if (!safeEqual(existingGuid, trimmedGuid)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            error: `Hardware Mismatch: Workstation ${stationLabel} is already locked to a different physical machine. Please request the Lab In-Charge to Reset Hardware Lock from the Live Cockpit.`,
          },
          { status: 403 }
        )
      }
    }

    // 5. Update Hardware Specs, LAN IP, and Last Seen Timestamp
    const reportedLanIp = hardware_specs?.lan_ip || clientIp || ws.lan_ip
    const boundGuid = isFirstTimePairing ? trimmedGuid : existingGuid

    const updateQuery = `
      UPDATE public.workstations
      SET 
        machine_guid = $1,
        hardware_specs = $2,
        lan_ip = COALESCE($3, lan_ip),
        last_seen_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = $4
      RETURNING id, label, machine_guid, lan_ip, last_seen_at
    `
    const updateRes = await pool.query(updateQuery, [
      boundGuid,
      hardware_specs ? JSON.stringify(hardware_specs) : null,
      reportedLanIp,
      workstationId,
    ])

    const updatedWs = updateRes.rows[0]

    // 6. Record Audit Event on First-Time Hardware Lock
    if (isFirstTimePairing) {
      await recordAuditEvent({
        action: 'UPDATE',
        entityType: 'workstation',
        entityId: workstationId,
        entityLabel: `Hardware Bound: ${stationLabel}`,
        before: { machine_guid: null },
        after: {
          machine_guid: boundGuid,
          lan_ip: reportedLanIp,
          cpu: hardware_specs?.cpu,
          ram_gb: hardware_specs?.ram_gb,
        },
        metadata: {
          event: 'TOFU_HARDWARE_LOCK_ENROLLED',
          client_ip: clientIp,
        },
      })
    }

    // 7. Generate 60-Second Single-Use Handshake Ticket
    const ticket = createHandshakeTicket({
      id: updatedWs.id,
      label: updatedWs.label,
      machine_guid: updatedWs.machine_guid,
    })

    // Construct origin-aware redirect URL
    const origin = req.nextUrl.origin
    const redirectUrl = `${origin}/terminal/auth?ticket=${encodeURIComponent(ticket)}`

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      station_code: updatedWs.label,
      workstation_id: updatedWs.id,
      machine_guid: updatedWs.machine_guid,
      redirect_url: redirectUrl,
      is_new_pairing: isFirstTimePairing,
    })
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error in terminal handshake route:', err)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: err.message || 'Internal server error during handshake.' },
      { status: 500 }
    )
  }
}

        {/* Development Environment Bypass (Only shown in local dev mode) */}
        {isDev && (
          <div className="space-y-2.5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 font-heading">
              <Laptop className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Dev Environment Simulation Override</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 text-center">
              Simulate launching from physical lab PC nodes (available in local dev mode only):
            </p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 pt-1">
              {commonStations.map((code) => (
                <Link
                  key={code}
                  href={`/terminal?dev_station=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`}
                  className="py-2 px-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/70 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:border-indigo-400 dark:hover:border-indigo-500/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 text-xs font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 transition-all text-center"
                >
                  {code}
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>

      <footer className="max-w-xl mx-auto w-full pb-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono">
        LabSync LIMS · Secondary &amp; Higher Secondary Academic Laboratory System
      </footer>

      {isDev && <TerminalSimulatorController />}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: app\terminal\auth\route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import {
  verifyHandshakeTicket,
  createTerminalSessionToken,
} from '@/lib/security/terminal-token'

/**
 * Authentication exchange route.
 * Converts a 60-second single-use handshake ticket into an HttpOnly session cookie,
 * then 302-redirects to clean URL /terminal (zero parameters or tokens in address bar).
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams
  const ticket = searchParams.get('ticket')

  const origin = req.nextUrl.origin

  if (!ticket) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL('/terminal?auth_error=missing_ticket', origin),
      { status: 302 }
    )
  }

  const verification = verifyHandshakeTicket(ticket)
  if (!verification.valid || !verification.payload) {
    const errorReason = encodeURIComponent(verification.reason || 'Ticket invalid or expired')
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`/terminal?auth_error=${errorReason}`, origin),
      { status: 302 }
    )
  }

  const { stationId, stationCode, machineGuid } = verification.payload

  // Create persistent HttpOnly session token
  const sessionToken = createTerminalSessionToken({
    id: stationId,
    label: stationCode,
    machine_guid: machineGuid,
  })

  // CRITICAL USER GUARDRAIL:
  // Only set secure: true when running in production AND over HTTPS.
  // In school lab deployments running over local LAN HTTP (http://192.168.1.x:3000),
  // hardcoding secure: true causes modern browsers to drop the cookie!
  const isHttps = req.nextUrl.protocol === 'https:'
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
  const isSecure = isProd && isHttps

  // Redirect to clean /terminal URL
  const response = NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/terminal', origin), {
    status: 302,
  })

  response.cookies.set('labsync_terminal_session', sessionToken, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'strict',
    path: '/',
    secure: isSecure,
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 12, // 12-hour school lab operational session
  })

  return response
}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useEffect, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  Lock,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Monitor,
  RefreshCw,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { pairWorkstationTerminal } from '@/app/actions/terminal'

function TerminalPairingContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const router = useRouter()
  const initialStation = searchParams.get('station') || ''
  const initialSecret = searchParams.get('secret') || searchParams.get('token') || ''

  const [stationCode, setStationCode] = useState(initialStation)
  const [lanIp, setLanIp] = useState('')
  const [isPairing, setIsPairing] = useState(false)
  const [pairingSuccess, setPairingSuccess] = useState(false)
  const [generatedToken, setGeneratedToken] = useState('')
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handlePair = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!stationCode.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please specify workstation label (e.g. PC-12 or A4).')
      return
    }

    setIsPairing(true)
    setErrorMsg(null)

    const res = await pairWorkstationTerminal(stationCode.trim(), initialSecret || undefined, lanIp || undefined)
    setIsPairing(false)

    if (res.success && res.pairingToken) {
      setGeneratedToken(res.pairingToken)
      setPairingSuccess(true)
      // Save pairing token to localStorage for persistent hardware lock
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem('labsync_paired_station', stationCode.trim())
        localStorage.setItem('labsync_paired_token', res.pairingToken)
        localStorage.setItem(`labsync_paired_token_${stationCode.trim()}`, res.pairingToken)
      }
    } else {
      setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Failed to pair workstation terminal.')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 shadow-2xl text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
      <div className="text-center space-y-2">
        <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
          <Lock className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-lg font-bold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
          Hardware Terminal Pairing Lock
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          Pair this browser to a physical workstation to enable anti-spoofing protection and 1-tap student assistance reporting.
        </p>
      </div>

      {pairingSuccess ? (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>Terminal Paired Successfully!</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300/90">
              This browser is now cryptographically bound to{' '}
              <strong className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-mono">{stationCode.trim()}</strong>. Reports from other desks cannot spoof this terminal.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400/80 break-all bg-emerald-100/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 p-2 rounded-lg border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/40">
              Token: {generatedToken}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2">
            <Button
              onClick={() => router.push(`/terminal/${encodeURIComponent(stationCode.trim())}`)}
              className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Launch Student Terminal View</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handlePair} className="space-y-4">
          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Workstation Label / Code</label>
            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. PC-12 or A4"
              value={stationCode}
              onChange={(e) => setStationCode(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-mono uppercase text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              Static LAN IP Address (Optional)
            </label>
            <Input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. 192.168.1.130"
              value={lanIp}
              onChange={(e) => setLanIp(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
              Network-level IP verification ensures reports originate from this physical LAN outlet.
            </p>
          </div>

          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPairing || !stationCode.trim()}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isPairing ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>Generating Cryptographic Pairing...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Pair Browser to Terminal</span>
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}

      <div className="border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800/80 pt-4 text-center">
        <Link href="/computer-lab" className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors">
          Return to Lab Floor Plan & Live Cockpit
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function TerminalPairPage() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 font-sans">
      <Suspense fallback={<div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono">Loading pairing security manager...</div>}>
        <TerminalPairingContent />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Monitor, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { getTerminalContext } from '@/app/actions/terminal'
import { StudentTerminalView } from '@/components/terminal/student-terminal-view'

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise<{ code: string }>
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { code } = await params
  const decodedCode = decodeURIComponent(code || '')
  return {
    title: `Terminal ${decodedCode} | LabSync LIMS`,
    description: `Zero-login student self-reporting interface for terminal ${decodedCode}`,
  }
}

export default async function TerminalPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { code } = await params
  const decodedCode = decodeURIComponent(code || '')

  const res = await getTerminalContext(decodedCode)

  if (!res.success || !res.data) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center font-sans">
        <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
          <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-lg font-bold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Workstation Not Recognized</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {res.error || `Could not find workstation "${decodedCode}" in the laboratory database.`}
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link
              href="/terminal"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl transition-all"
            >
              <Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Select Lab Terminal</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return <StudentTerminalView initialData={res.data} />
}
